title: Mastering Renko Trading
subtitle: A Practical Visual System for Reading Trends, Filtering Noise, Planning Entries, Managing Risk, and Testing Renko Strategies
summary:
Mastering Renko Trading presents Renko as a visual framework for filtering some time-based chart noise and studying price movement through brick construction. The book focuses on reading trends, organizing entries, managing risk and turning Renko observations into rules that can be tested rather than treating the cleaner chart as automatic proof of a better strategy.

Its practical orientation connects visual pattern recognition to entry planning, stop logic, position risk and strategy validation. The central goal is to use Renko deliberately as a transformed view of price while keeping the trading process explicit enough to review and improve.
target_audience: For technical traders who want a practical visual introduction to Renko charts with explicit attention to entries, risk and testing.
seo_description: A practical visual Renko trading guide to trend reading, noise filtering, entry planning, risk management and strategy testing.
learning: Understand Renko as a transformed visual representation rather than a replacement for disciplined execution.
Read trend and price movement with less dependence on ordinary time-based candle noise.
Translate Renko observations into explicit entry and invalidation rules.
Plan position risk rather than relying on visual cleanliness.
Test Renko strategies with repeatable definitions before drawing performance conclusions.

title: Confluence Trading
subtitle: A Visual Practical Guide to Combining Price Action, Market Structure, Key Levels, Multiple Timeframes, and Risk
summary:
Confluence Trading treats confluence as a way to organize evidence, not a score that makes uncertainty disappear. The early chapters distinguish independent evidence from duplicate evidence and put market structure and location before indicators. Key levels, price action, support and resistance, Fibonacci, moving averages, momentum, volume and multiple timeframes are evaluated according to what new information they add rather than how many boxes they allow the trader to tick.

The later sections turn analysis into a trade thesis with a separate trigger, invalidation and risk budget. Conflicting evidence can reduce or cancel a setup, and risk is allowed to veto a visually beautiful chart. Trend pullback, breakout/retest, reversal and range-bound setups lead into hidden-right-edge exercises, a personal confluence playbook, backtest logs, pre-trade and post-trade worksheets and a visual appendix.
target_audience: For discretionary traders who combine several technical tools and want to reduce duplicate evidence, confirmation shopping and false confidence.
seo_description: A practical confluence trading guide to independent versus duplicate evidence, structure, location, price action, levels, Fibonacci, moving averages, timeframes, invalidation, risk, setups and testing.
learning: Distinguish independent evidence from multiple indicators that repeat the same information.
Put structure and location before confluence counting.
Use Fibonacci, moving averages, momentum and volume as context only when they add distinct evidence.
Separate thesis, trigger, invalidation and risk instead of treating confluence as an entry by itself.
Build and test a personal confluence playbook with worksheets and outcome-independent process grading.

title: Beyond the Single Candle
subtitle: A Visual Field Guide to Inside Bars, Engulfing Patterns, and Two-Candle Price Action
summary:
Beyond the Single Candle moves away from memorizing isolated candlestick names and studies what changes from Candle 1 to Candle 2. Range, body and close location are kept as separate dimensions so an Inside Bar, body engulfing pattern or Outside Bar has a mechanical definition before context is interpreted. Compression is treated as an observable condition, not a directional prediction.

Mother-bar breaks, close confirmation, break-and-retest entries, false breakouts and engulfing relationships are compared with their different information costs. No-trade rules, invalidation and context are defined with the same precision as entry conditions. A two-candle worksheet and personal playbook encourage the reader to record facts, assumptions and risk before revealing the outcome, making the framework suitable for replay and testing.
target_audience: For candlestick and price-action traders who want to replace pattern memorization with a more precise, testable reading of two-candle relationships.
seo_description: A visual two-candle price-action guide to Inside Bars, engulfing patterns, Outside Bars, compression, breakouts, failed breaks, entry styles, invalidation and testing.
learning: Describe the relationship between two candles before reaching for a pattern name.
Keep range, body and close location as separate pieces of evidence.
Define strict Inside Bars, engulfing patterns and Outside Bars consistently.
Compare breakout, close-confirmation and break-retest entry styles with explicit invalidation.
Use worksheets and versioned rules to test false breaks and two-candle setups without hindsight.

title: Geld folgt Geld
subtitle: Wenn du Geld verdienen willst, gib anderen Werkzeuge, mit denen sie Geld verdienen können
summary: Geld folgt Geld entwickelt einen praxisnahen Rahmen für wirtschaftlichen Wert statt eines Reichtumsversprechens. Der Titel bedeutet nicht, dass Geld magisch weiteres Geld anzieht; gemeint ist, dass Angebote näher an echte Kaufentscheidungen rücken, wenn sie Probleme bei Umsatz, Kosten, Zeit, Risiko, Fehlern oder produktiver Kapazität lösen. Das Buch zeigt, wie man teure wiederkehrende Probleme findet, den Käufer vor dem Produkt versteht, Beschwerden als Marktsignale nutzt, Reibung reduziert, zunächst manuell testet, verkauft bevor alles gebaut ist und Ergebnisse nach dem Kauf misst. Spätere Kapitel verbinden Produktstufen, Beweise, Inhalte, Preisgestaltung, Vertrauen, Systeme, Produktisierung, Ökosysteme und Reinvestition zu einer Wertmaschine.
target_audience: Für Gründer, Freelancer, Berater, Kreative und kleine Unternehmen, die reale Kundenprobleme in nützliche Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Systeme übersetzen möchten.
seo_description: Praxisleitfaden zu teuren Problemen, Kundenerkenntnis, wirtschaftlichem Wert, Nachfragevalidierung, Preisgestaltung, Vertrauen, Systemen, Produktisierung und Wachstum.
learning: Probleme identifizieren, die mit Umsatz, Kosten, Zeit, Risiko oder produktiver Kapazität verbunden sind.
Käufer, bestehende Ausgaben und wiederkehrende Beschwerden untersuchen, bevor ein Produkt gebaut wird.
Eine kleine nutzbare Lösung manuell validieren, bevor automatisiert oder skaliert wird.
Ergebnisse nach dem Kauf messen und Kundenerfolg in Produktwissen verwandeln.
Preis, Inhalte und Expertise auf nachweisbaren Wert statt auf Statusbehauptungen stützen.
Wiederholbare Lieferung in Systeme und sinnvolle verbundene Angebote überführen.
Vertrauen als wirtschaftlichen Vermögenswert schützen und in eine stärkere Wertschleife reinvestieren.

title: El dinero sigue al dinero
subtitle: Si quieres ganar dinero, da a los demás herramientas para ganarlo
summary: El dinero sigue al dinero presenta un marco práctico para crear valor económico sin prometer riqueza. La idea central no es que el dinero se multiplique mágicamente, sino que una oferta se acerca a una decisión de compra cuando resuelve problemas ligados a ingresos, costes, tiempo, riesgo, errores o capacidad productiva. El libro enseña a detectar problemas caros y repetidos, conocer al comprador antes de construir, convertir quejas en señales de mercado, vender reducción de fricción, empezar manualmente antes de automatizar, probar la venta antes de construirlo todo y medir lo que ocurre después de la compra. Después desarrolla escalones de producto, evidencia, contenido, precio, confianza, sistemas, productización, ecosistemas y reinversión hasta llegar a una máquina de valor basada en problema, herramienta, acción del cliente, resultado, prueba, confianza, distribución y aprendizaje.
target_audience: Para emprendedores, freelancers, consultores, creadores y pequeñas empresas que quieren convertir problemas reales de clientes en productos, servicios y sistemas útiles.
seo_description: Guía práctica para detectar problemas caros, construir herramientas útiles, validar demanda, medir valor para el cliente, fijar precios, crear sistemas y crecer con confianza.
learning: Detectar problemas cercanos a ingresos, costes, tiempo, riesgo o capacidad productiva sin recurrir a promesas de riqueza.
Estudiar al comprador, el gasto existente y las quejas repetidas antes de construir.
Validar una solución pequeña y utilizable antes de automatizar o ampliar.
Medir lo que ocurre después de la compra y convertir el éxito del cliente en conocimiento de producto.
Construir precios, contenido y autoridad alrededor de valor demostrable.
Convertir una entrega repetible en sistema y después en un ecosistema útil sin fabricar complejidad innecesaria.
Tratar la confianza como un activo económico y reinvertir para fortalecer el ciclo de valor.

title: L’argent suit l’argent
subtitle: Si vous voulez gagner de l’argent, donnez aux autres des outils qui leur permettent d’en gagner
summary: L’argent suit l’argent propose un cadre pratique pour construire de la valeur économique sans promettre la richesse. Le titre ne signifie pas que l’argent attire magiquement l’argent; il indique qu’une offre se rapproche d’une décision d’achat lorsqu’elle résout un problème lié au revenu, au coût, au temps, au risque, aux erreurs ou à la capacité productive. Le livre apprend à repérer les problèmes coûteux et récurrents, comprendre le client avant de construire, transformer les plaintes en signaux de marché, réduire la friction, commencer manuellement avant d’automatiser, tester la vente avant de tout bâtir et mesurer ce qui se passe après l’achat. Les derniers chapitres relient gamme de produits, preuves, contenu, prix, confiance, systèmes, productisation, écosystèmes et réinvestissement dans une machine à valeur.
target_audience: Pour entrepreneurs, freelances, consultants, créateurs et petites entreprises qui veulent transformer des problèmes clients réels en produits, services et systèmes utiles.
seo_description: Guide pratique pour repérer les problèmes coûteux, construire des outils utiles, valider la demande, mesurer la valeur client, fixer les prix, créer des systèmes et grandir par la confiance.
learning: Repérer les problèmes proches du revenu, du coût, du temps, du risque ou de la capacité productive sans promettre la richesse.
Étudier le client, les dépenses existantes et les plaintes répétées avant de construire.
Valider manuellement une petite solution utile avant d’automatiser ou d’élargir.
Mesurer ce qui arrive après l’achat et transformer la réussite client en connaissance produit.
Construire prix, contenu et crédibilité autour d’une valeur démontrable.
Transformer une livraison répétable en système puis en écosystème utile sans fabriquer de complexité artificielle.
Protéger la confiance comme un actif économique et réinvestir dans une boucle de valeur plus forte.

title: Para Paranın Peşinden Gider:
subtitle: Para kazanmak istiyorsan, başkalarına para kazandıran araçlar sun
summary: Para Paranın Peşinden Gider, zenginlik formülü satmak yerine ekonomik değere yaklaşan bir iş kurma çerçevesi sunar. Kitap başlığını büyülü bir para çoğalması olarak değil; gelir, maliyet, zaman, risk, hata ve üretken kapasiteyle bağlantılı problemlere yaklaşmak olarak açıklar. Okuru pahalı ve tekrarlanan sorunları bulmaya, üründen önce müşteriyi ve harcama davranışını anlamaya, şikâyetleri pazar sinyaline çevirmeye, sürtünmeyi azaltmaya, otomasyondan önce elle test etmeye, her şeyi kurmadan önce satış ihtimalini doğrulamaya ve satın alma sonrasındaki gerçek sonucu ölçmeye yönlendirir. Sonraki bölümler ürün merdiveni, kanıt, içerik, fiyatlama, güven, sistem, ürünleştirme, ekosistem ve yeniden yatırım üzerinden bir değer makinesi kurar.
target_audience: Gerçek müşteri sorunlarından ürün, hizmet veya sistem üretmek isteyen girişimciler, serbest çalışanlar, danışmanlar, içerik üreticileri ve küçük işletme sahipleri için.
seo_description: Pahalı problemler, müşteri keşfi, ekonomik değer, ürün doğrulama, fiyatlama, güven, sistemler, ürünleştirme ve sürdürülebilir büyüme üzerine pratik iş kurma rehberi.
learning: Gelir, maliyet, zaman, risk ve üretken kapasiteyle bağlantılı sorunları ekonomik değer açısından değerlendirmek.
Üründen önce müşteriyi, mevcut harcamayı ve tekrar eden şikâyetleri incelemek.
Otomasyon ve ölçekten önce elle çalışan küçük bir çözümle gerçek talebi test etmek.
Satın alma sonrasındaki sonucu ölçüp müşteri başarısını ürün bilgisine dönüştürmek.
Fiyat, içerik ve uzmanlık iddialarını kanıtlanabilir değer üzerine kurmak.
Tekrarlanabilir teslimi sisteme, sistemi ise doğal ve müşteriyi güçlendiren bir ekosisteme dönüştürmek.
Güveni finansal bir varlık gibi korumak ve kazancın bir bölümünü değer makinesini güçlendirmeye geri koymak.

title: Money Follows Money:
subtitle: If You Want to Make Money, Give Other People Tools to Make It
summary: Money Follows Money is a practical business-building framework centered on economic value rather than wealth promises. The title does not mean that money magically attracts money; it means that businesses move closer to purchase decisions when they solve problems tied to revenue, cost, time, risk, error, or productive capacity. The book teaches readers to identify expensive recurring problems, understand the buyer before building, turn complaints into market clues, sell reduced friction, test manually before automating, validate a sale before overbuilding, measure what happens after purchase, and convert customer success into product knowledge. Later chapters develop entry, core, and professional products, useful free offers, evidence-based expertise, searchable content, systems, pricing, trust, productization, ecosystems, reinvestment, and a final value-machine loop linking problem, tool, customer action, result, proof, trust, distribution, learning, and a better tool.
target_audience: For creators, consultants, founders, freelancers, educators and small-business builders who want a grounded method for turning real customer problems into useful products, services and systems.
seo_description: A practical business guide to finding expensive problems, building useful tools, validating demand, proving customer value, pricing, systems, trust, productization and sustainable growth.
learning: Identify business problems close to revenue, cost, time, risk or productive capacity without making wealth promises.
Study the buyer, existing spending and recurring complaints before building a product.
Start with a usable tool or service and validate transactions before automating or expanding.
Measure the outcome after purchase and turn customer success or failure into product knowledge.
Build product ladders, pricing and content around demonstrated value rather than status claims.
Turn repeatable delivery into systems and connected offerings without trapping customers in unnecessary complexity.
Treat trust as an economic asset and reinvest part of improved economics into a stronger value loop.

title: Cuando el dinero no alcanza
subtitle: Cómo cambiar los gastos de alimentación, vivienda, salud, transporte y vida cotidiana en épocas de presión económica sin dañar lo que de verdad importa
summary: Cuando el dinero no alcanza propone un método de decisión para cuando los ingresos ya no cubren el coste real de una vida razonable. Distingue entre ahorrar, sustituir y cambiar el modelo de vida; ordena los gastos por la función que cumplen; protege salud, seguridad, capacidad de trabajar, futuro y dignidad; y aplica esa lógica a comida, vivienda, transporte, medicación, educación, familia, deuda, ahorros y recuperación financiera. Su objetivo no es construir la vida más barata posible, sino la vida sostenible de menor coste que cause el menor daño a lo que resulta difícil reconstruir.
key_topics: Ahorro, sustitución y cambio de modelo
target_audience: Para lectores generales que atraviesan presión económica y necesitan reorganizar gastos esenciales y cotidianos sin sacrificar innecesariamente salud, seguridad, relaciones, futuro o dignidad.
seo_description: Una guía práctica para reorganizar alimentación, vivienda, salud, transporte y vida cotidiana bajo presión económica sin destruir la salud, la seguridad, la familia, el futuro ni la dignidad.
learning: Distinguir pequeños recortes de un déficit estructural.
Separar la necesidad de la forma concreta de pagarla.
Clasificar gastos por importancia y daño potencial.
Comparar el ahorro visible con costes ocultos en salud, tiempo, seguridad y futuro.
Calcular costes reales de comida, vivienda, transporte y pagos automáticos.
Definir mejor el uso de ahorros, deuda y fondo de emergencia.
Tomar decisiones familiares compartidas sin convertir el presupuesto en una búsqueda de culpables.
Evitar reconstruir automáticamente todos los gastos antiguos cuando mejoren los ingresos.

title: Para Yetmediğinde
subtitle: Ekonomik baskı dönemlerinde gıda, barınma, sağlık, ulaşım ve günlük yaşam giderlerini, hayatın önemli parçalarına zarar vermeden nasıl değiştirebiliriz
summary: Para Yetmediğinde, gelirin artık makul bir hayatın gerçek maliyetini karşılamadığı dönemler için karar verme yöntemi sunar. Tasarruf, ikame ve model değişikliğini birbirinden ayırır; giderleri işlevine göre önceliklendirir; sağlık, güvenlik, çalışma kapasitesi, gelecek ve onur tabanını korur; bu yaklaşımı gıda, konut, ulaşım, ilaç, eğitim, aile, borç, birikim ve mali toparlanmaya uygular. Amaç en ucuz hayatı değil, önemli olanı mümkün olduğunca koruyan en düşük maliyetli sürdürülebilir hayatı kurmaktır.
target_audience: Ekonomik baskı altında gıda, barınma, ulaşım, sağlık, eğitim, borç ve günlük tüketim kararlarını yeniden düzenlemek isteyen genel okur için.
seo_description: Ekonomik baskı dönemlerinde gıda, barınma, sağlık, ulaşım ve günlük yaşam giderlerini; sağlık, güvenlik, aile, gelecek ve özsaygıya mümkün olduğunca az zarar vererek yeniden düzenleme rehberi.
learning: Küçük tasarruf sorununu yapısal bütçe açığından ayırmak.
İhtiyacı onu karşılama biçiminden ayırmak.
Giderleri önem ve olası zarara göre sınıflandırmak.
Görünür tasarrufu sağlık, zaman, güvenlik ve gelecek üzerindeki gizli maliyetle birlikte değerlendirmek.
Yemek, konut, ulaşım ve otomatik ödemelerin gerçek maliyetini hesaplamak.
Birikim, borç ve acil durum fonu için daha açık kurallar geliştirmek.
Aile içi bütçe kararlarını suçlama yerine ortak bilgiyle yürütmek.
Gelir artınca eski tüm giderleri otomatik olarak geri getirmemek.

title: When Money Runs Short
subtitle: How to change the cost of food, housing, healthcare, transport, and everyday life when finances are tight—without damaging what matters most
summary: When Money Runs Short is a practical decision guide for periods when income no longer covers the real cost of living and small frugality tips are not enough. It distinguishes three levels of response—saving, substitution, and changing the model of daily life—then applies them to food, housing, transport, healthcare, clothing, education, family life, debt, savings, and recovery. The book asks readers to separate needs from the expensive ways those needs are currently met, rank expenses by the harm caused if they disappear, protect a realistic dignity floor, and examine large structural costs before exhausting themselves over tiny purchases. Its workbook turns the framework into concrete tools for mapping the monthly shortfall, comparing the real cost of a car or home, calculating cost per meal and cost per use, reviewing automatic payments, mapping debt, defining emergency-reserve rules, and testing non-essential expenses through a thirty-day absence experiment.
target_audience: For general readers facing a period in which income no longer comfortably covers the real cost of living and who need to restructure essential and everyday expenses without causing unnecessary damage to health, safety, work, relationships, future capacity or self-respect.
seo_description: A practical guide to surviving financial pressure by redesigning food, housing, healthcare, transport and everyday costs while protecting health, safety, work, family, future and dignity.
learning: Distinguish a small frugality problem from a structural monthly shortfall that requires larger changes.
Separate the underlying need from the current way of paying for or meeting that need.
Classify expenses by what breaks if they disappear rather than by price alone.
Protect health, safety, the ability to work, children’s future, and a realistic dignity floor while cutting costs.
Compare the true cost of food, housing, transport, automatic payments and ownership rather than relying on headline prices.
Use cost-per-meal, cost-per-use and total-cost thinking to compare alternatives more accurately.
Create clearer rules for emergency reserves, debt, savings and family decision-making under pressure.
Test whether a non-essential expense is truly needed by pausing it and observing the real consequences before deciding permanently.

title: ChatGPT 6 Astra
subtitle: The New Things You Can Do: What Changed, What It Can Build, and When to Choose It Over Gemini and Grok
summary: ChatGPT 6 Astra is a September 2026 launch-edition guide focused on the practical shift from asking an AI for advice to delegating reviewable end-to-end work. The book examines computer use, browser-based workflows, finished documents, spreadsheets and presentations, websites and lightweight apps, coding and testing, 3D and CAD work, games, long-context research, real-world web tasks, and multi-step delegation. It emphasizes outcome-based instructions, explicit boundaries, definitions of done, mid-course steering, approval gates, testing, and human judgment rather than treating benchmark scores or model confidence as proof. Later chapters compare Astra with GPT-5.6, Gemini and Grok, discuss when a frontier model is worth the extra cost, and provide a delegation card, developer quickstart, twenty before-and-after request patterns, seven launch labs, a buyer’s guide and time-bounded verified source notes.
target_audience: For creators, developers, office and knowledge workers, AI power users, technical teams, and buyers who want a practical, time-bounded guide to what GPT-6 Astra changes, what to test, where human judgment still matters, and when a lower-cost model may be the better choice.
seo_description: A practical September 2026 launch guide to GPT-6 Astra covering computer use, professional artifacts, Sites, coding, 3D, long-context research, delegation, model routing, costs, limitations and hands-on labs.
learning: Understand the practical difference between a stronger answer model and a system designed to carry multi-step work toward a finished artifact.
Delegate outcomes with goals, context, boundaries, freedom, a definition of done and explicit stop conditions.
Test computer use, artifact creation, steering and restraint with observable tasks rather than trivia or prose-only demos.
Use AI for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, websites, code and visual or spatial work while keeping verification in the workflow.
Treat long context as working capacity rather than perfect memory and structure evidence accordingly.
Choose a cheaper model when it already meets the acceptance standard and reserve Astra for tasks where integrated capabilities reduce repair or iteration.
Design approval gates before granting consequential or irreversible permissions.
Interpret launch benchmarks and vendor-reported evaluations with attention to harnesses, task design, price and the limits of generalization.

title: Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1
subtitle: The Frontier Agent Playbook: A Practical Operating Manual for Long-Horizon AI Agents, Coding, Research, Knowledge Work, Tools, Verification, Safety, and Production Systems
summary: Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1: The Frontier Agent Playbook treats frontier models as components inside an engineered operating system rather than as magical chatbots. The book begins with the shift from short conversations to long-horizon delegated work and explains when Fable 5.1 is justified, how Mythos 5.1 changes the access and safeguard boundary, and why routing should follow task shape, evidence, cost, latency, permissions, and failure risk rather than model prestige. It develops executable specifications, definitions of done, authority matrices, effort calibration, model routing, context hierarchies, compaction, explicit state, bounded tools, least privilege, read-back verification, parallel work, long-running state machines, retries, replanning, stop conditions, multi-agent handoffs, and coordination budgets. Applied chapters cover repository-level coding, debugging, PRD-to-product execution, deep research, PDFs and charts, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific workflows. Production chapters address caching, batching, cost per completed task, observability, evaluation, safeguards, approvals, and an independent verifier. The closing reference architecture separates intake, task specification, routing, context, tools, runtime, state, artifact storage, permissions, verification, observability, safeguards, evaluation, and delivery, followed by a thirty-day production roadmap and operational scorecards.
target_audience: For AI engineers, software developers, agent builders, technical product leaders, researchers, automation architects, and advanced Claude users who need to design long-running, tool-using systems that are observable, verifiable, permission-aware, cost-conscious, and safe enough for production work.
seo_description: A practical engineering manual for Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 covering long-horizon agents, model routing, context, tools, verification, multi-agent systems, coding, research, safety, economics, observability, and production architecture.
learning: Decide when a frontier model is justified instead of using the most capable model by default.
Distinguish model capability from the agent harness, runtime, access policy, and safeguard configuration that shape observed behavior.
Turn a vague task into an executable work contract with outcome, boundaries, authority, evidence, and escalation paths.
Manage very large context windows with source hierarchy, retrieval timing, compaction, and explicit durable state.
Design tools with strict schemas, least privilege, failure semantics, identifiers, and independent read-back verification.
Build long-horizon execution around milestones, artifacts, state machines, bounded retries, recovery, and legitimate stop conditions.
Use multi-agent structures only when independence, specialization, or parallelism justifies their coordination cost.
Apply the framework to codebases, research, documents, spreadsheets, slides, computer use, and scientific work.
Measure completed-work economics with cache, batch, tool loops, retries, latency, human repair, and strict success rather than raw token price alone.
Separate the builder's claim of completion from an independent verifier and production evaluation layer.

title: The High-Income FDE
subtitle: A Visual Guide to the High-Paying World of Forward Deployed Engineers, Their Workflows, Enterprise AI Deployments, and How They Operate in the Field
summary:
The High-Income FDE is a combined visual operating system and deep-dive text companion for understanding Forward Deployed Engineering as the discipline of turning general technical capability into a specific, trusted, repeatable customer outcome. The visual volume maps the role through deployment loops, discovery, integration, architecture, governance, adoption, economics, handoff and productization; the independent text companion then explains the mechanisms, trade-offs, failure conditions, operating decisions and career implications in depth.

The book treats the last mile as an engineering problem rather than a final installation step. It distinguishes installed, used, trusted and expanded deployments; defines the FDE as a builder, diplomat, operator and signal carrier; and shows how discovery changes architecture, architecture changes evaluation, evaluation changes autonomy, operability changes trust, trust changes adoption, adoption changes economics, and economics determines what should become reusable product. Later chapters cover integration risk, data and identity contracts, AI placement, deterministic versus probabilistic work, evaluation, security, observability, incident response, adoption, change management, cost and value, handoff, scaling the deployment organization, interview judgment, portfolio evidence, compensation and career sustainability, and the future of AI FDEs. Practical appendices provide qualification, discovery, success-plan, production-readiness, incident, adoption and handoff tools.
target_audience: For software engineers moving toward customer-facing deployment, solutions and product engineers seeking deeper ownership, AI and platform engineers working in enterprise environments, technical leaders designing an FDE organization, operators evaluating embedded engineering, and candidates preparing for FDE interviews or portfolios. Basic familiarity with software systems, APIs, data and cloud concepts is assumed; AI research expertise is not required.
seo_description: A comprehensive visual and text field guide to Forward Deployed Engineering, enterprise AI deployment, customer discovery, architecture, security, evals, adoption, economics, handoff, productization, interviews and career leverage.
learning: Distinguish a convincing demo from a deployment that survives real customer data, permissions, exceptions, governance, cost and operational constraints.
Use installed, used, trusted and expanded as separate deployment maturity states with different evidence requirements.
Define the FDE role through outcome ownership and the combined builder, diplomat, operator and product-signal responsibilities rather than by job title alone.
Perform discovery as fieldwork by observing workflows, artifacts, exceptions and tacit knowledge instead of relying only on stated requirements.
Qualify engagements, choose a thin first slice, define acceptance criteria and set exit conditions before deep deployment work begins.
Design integration, data, identity, permissions, AI placement, evaluation, security, observability and rollback as parts of one production operating system.
Measure adoption, economics and operational trust, then convert repeated field friction into reusable product capability instead of permanent services work.
Build stronger FDE interview and portfolio evidence by showing architecture, constraints, production operation, failure handling, communication and measurable outcomes.

title: Claude AI Side Hustle
subtitle: 200 Profitable Side Hustles: Visual Step-by-Step High-Income Ideas, Money-Making Services & Fast-Start Offers
summary: Claude AI Side Hustle is a visual catalog of 200 service and product ideas organized around content creation, AI writing, business support, design, online courses, automation, marketing, and digital products. Its recurring five-stage funnel moves from discovering an opportunity to creating, delivering, marketing, and scaling it. Each visual idea identifies what can be sold, who may buy it, how Claude can assist, a possible pricing model, a first-sale action, startup effort, cash-speed and repeatability indicators, plus a reality check against exaggerated promises.
target_audience: For freelancers, creators, job seekers, solo operators, and small-business builders looking for concrete AI-assisted offer ideas.
seo_description: A visual guide to 200 Claude AI side hustles with what to sell, who buys, AI-assisted delivery, pricing models, first-sale steps, and reality checks.
learning: Scan 200 concrete side-hustle formats across multiple service and product categories.
Define a sellable deliverable and a plausible buyer before building an offer.
Use Claude to accelerate research, drafting, customization, and delivery without inventing client facts.
Compare startup effort, cash speed, repeatability, and per-project or package models.
Move from opportunity discovery to delivery, marketing, referrals, and scaling.

title: Kimi K3 and the Agentic Frontier
subtitle: Open Weights, Million-Token Context, Agent Swarms, and a Practical Comparison with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex
summary: Kimi K3 and the Agentic Frontier examines modern agentic AI by separating the model, harness, agent, product, and infrastructure layers that are often conflated. The book studies long context versus memory and compaction, sparse mixture-of-experts design, native vision, open weights, serving and self-hosting, agent swarms, sandboxed execution, economics, failure modes, benchmarks, and product-level comparisons with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Time-sensitive specifications and vendor claims are treated as dated evidence rather than timeless facts.
target_audience: For AI engineers, researchers, developers, and technical decision-makers comparing agentic systems and deployment models.
seo_description: A practical technical guide to Kimi K3, open weights, long context, agent swarms, serving, benchmarks, and comparisons with Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.
learning: Distinguish a foundation model from its harness, agent layer, product surface, and infrastructure.
Evaluate long-context claims separately from memory, retrieval, and compaction strategies.
Understand open-weight deployment, serving constraints, and swarm economics.
Compare agent products through controlled tasks, latency, cost, and human-attention requirements.
Read vendor specifications and benchmark claims with explicit dates, evidence, and limitations.

title: Akıllı İnsanlar Neden Parayla İlgili Kötü Kararlar Verir?
subtitle: Kazanmanın, Harcamanın, Biriktirmenin, Risk Almanın ve Servet Oluşturmanın Gizli Psikolojisi
summary: Akıllı İnsanlar Neden Parayla İlgili Kötü Kararlar Verir?, doğru finansal kararı bilmek ile onu gerçek hayatta uygulamak arasındaki boşluğu inceler. Zekânın; aileden devralınan para kurallarına, kimlik baskısına, korkuya, statü arzusuna, ruh hâline, alışkanlıklara, bugünü geleceğe tercih etme eğilimine ve belirsizliğe karşı bağışıklık sağlamadığını gösterir. İlk para derslerinden ve kimsenin yazmadığı aile defterinden başlayarak duygusal harcamaya, cüzdandaki seyirciye, daha fazlanın normalleşmesine, gelecekteki benliğe, görünmeyen alternatife, otomasyona ve iradeye ihtiyaç duymadan önce verilen kararlara ilerler. Daha sonra beceri, kanıt, güven ve kaldıraç üzerinden daha fazla kazanmanın psikolojisini; borç, risk ve dayanıklılığı ele alır. Son bölümler serveti seçenekler, hayır diyebilme hakkı ve yeter sınırıyla ilişkilendirir; okur defteri somut deneyler sunar.
target_audience: Temel kişisel finans kurallarını bilen ama zeki insanların baskı, alışkanlık, kimlik, korku ve sosyal karşılaştırma altında neden tutarsız para kararları verdiğini anlamak isteyen okurlar, profesyoneller ve aileler için.
seo_description: Miras alınan para inançları, duygusal harcama, statü, gelecek benliği, gelir, borç, risk, finansal özgürlük ve daha iyi para kararları üzerine uygulamalı psikoloji rehberi.
learning: Finansal bilgiyi gerçek kararları yöneten psikolojik güçlerden ayırmak.
Aileden devralınan kuralları ve kimlik baskılarını fark etmek.
Duygu ve statü kaynaklı harcamaları alışkanlığa dönüşmeden tanımak.
Fırsat maliyeti, otomasyon ve önceden verilmiş kurallarla geleceği somutlaştırmak.
Beceri, kanıt ve kaldıraçla gelir gücünü artırmak.
Kararı yalnız sonucuna göre değil süreç ve risk kalitesine göre değerlendirmek.
Borç ve kırılganlığı görünür sözleşmelere, stres testlerine ve tamponlara çevirmek.
Yeter sınırını tanımlayıp parayı seçenek ve hayır diyebilme kapasitesi için kullanmak.

title: Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras
subtitle: La psicología oculta de ganar, gastar, ahorrar, asumir riesgos y crear riqueza
summary: Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras estudia la distancia entre saber qué decisión parece sensata y ser capaz de tomarla cuando intervienen la historia familiar, la identidad, el miedo, el estatus, el cansancio, el hábito, el presente y la incertidumbre. El libro comienza con las primeras lecciones de dinero y el libro de cuentas familiar que nadie escribió; después analiza compras emocionales y de estatus, la normalización de un nivel de gasto mayor, la relación con el yo futuro, el coste de oportunidad, el ahorro automático y la tensión entre voluntad y diseño del entorno. Más adelante pasa a la psicología de ganar más: habilidades con valor de mercado, confianza basada en pruebas, negociación y palancas. La parte de riesgo distingue una buena decisión de un buen resultado, trata la deuda como contrato antes que emoción y propone construir una vida capaz de soportar errores. El cuaderno del lector y el laboratorio de decisiones convierten las ideas en experimentos y casos hipotéticos.
key_topics: Yo futuro y sesgo hacia el presente
target_audience: Para lectores, profesionales y hogares que conocen las reglas básicas de las finanzas personales pero quieren comprender por qué personas inteligentes siguen tomando decisiones inconsistentes bajo presión, hábito, identidad, miedo y comparación social.
seo_description: Guía práctica de psicología financiera sobre creencias heredadas, gasto emocional, estatus, yo futuro, ahorro, ingresos, deuda, riesgo, libertad financiera y mejores decisiones con dinero.
learning: Separar el conocimiento financiero de las fuerzas psicológicas que gobiernan una decisión real.
Detectar reglas familiares heredadas e identidades que condicionan ingresos, gasto, ahorro y riesgo.
Reconocer compras emocionales, de estatus o demasiado fáciles antes de que se conviertan en hábito.
Hacer concretos los costes futuros mediante alternativas visibles, automatización y reglas previas.
Aumentar el valor de una hora desarrollando habilidades útiles, pruebas de competencia y mejores palancas.
Evaluar una decisión por su proceso y su riesgo, no solamente por el resultado.
Convertir deuda y fragilidad financiera en contratos visibles, pruebas de estrés y márgenes de seguridad.
Definir un límite personal de suficiente y usar el dinero para comprar opciones y capacidad de decir no.

title: Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions
subtitle: The Hidden Psychology of Earning, Spending, Saving, Risk, and Building Wealth
summary: Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions examines the gap between knowing what is financially sensible and actually doing it. Intelligence does not make a person immune to inherited money rules, family history, identity, fear, status pressure, mood, habit, present bias, uncertainty, or the social meaning attached to spending. The book moves from early money lessons and the unwritten family ledger into emotional and status-sensitive purchases, lifestyle normalization, the conflict between present and future selves, opportunity cost, automation, earning power, marketable skills, confidence built from evidence, leverage, debt, risk, and the need to build a life that can survive being wrong. The final sections widen wealth beyond accumulation to relationships, financial buffers, the ability to say no, and a personal boundary for enough. A reader's notebook supplies twelve practical experiments and a decision lab uses hypothetical cases to make the psychological mechanisms visible.
target_audience: For thoughtful readers, professionals, entrepreneurs, and households who understand basic financial principles but want to understand why intelligent people still make inconsistent money decisions under pressure, habit, identity, fear, and social influence.
seo_description: A practical behavioral-finance guide to inherited money rules, spending psychology, status, future-self decisions, earning power, debt, risk, financial freedom, and better money habits.
learning: Separate financial knowledge from the psychological forces that shape real decisions.
Identify inherited family rules and identity pressures that influence earning, spending, saving, and risk.
Recognize mood-driven, status-sensitive, and frictionless purchasing before it becomes a repeated pattern.
Make future tradeoffs more concrete through opportunity-cost framing, automation, and pre-decided rules.
Increase earning power by mapping valuable skills, adjacent capabilities, evidence, and leverage.
Judge financial decisions by process and risk rather than by outcome alone.
Turn debt and fragility into visible contracts, stress tests, buffers, and explicit boundaries.
Use practical experiments to define enough, strengthen the right to say no, and build quieter financial freedom.

title: Candlestick Patterns From Zero
subtitle: A Visual Trading Course for Beginners
summary: Candlestick Patterns From Zero is a 100-page visual course that teaches candlestick reading from basic OHLC anatomy through pattern recognition, market context, confirmation and risk-aware execution. The book treats candle patterns as clues rather than guarantees: readers learn to interpret bodies and wicks, bullish and bearish candles, doji structures, hammers, shooting stars, engulfing patterns, harami patterns, morning and evening stars, multi-candle formations and gaps while checking trend, support and resistance, volume, volatility and higher-level context. Later lessons connect recognition to practical decision rules for entry triggers, stop-loss placement, targets, risk-reward, invalidation and confirmation.
target_audience: For beginner and early-intermediate traders who want a highly visual introduction to candlestick reading, pattern context, confirmation and risk-aware execution.
seo_description: A 100-page visual beginner course on candlestick anatomy, OHLC, candle psychology, reversal and continuation patterns, confirmation, context, risk, entries, stops and targets.
learning: Read open, high, low and close structure and interpret candle bodies and wicks.
Recognize common bullish, bearish and neutral candlestick formations without treating them as automatic signals.
Judge patterns in relation to trend, support and resistance, volume, volatility and market location.
Wait for confirmation and define an entry trigger instead of entering solely because a pattern appears.
Place stops beyond logical invalidation points and map targets from chart structure.
Evaluate risk-reward and know when a technically attractive pattern is still a poor trade.
Use a confirmation ladder and reliability checklist to turn pattern literacy into a repeatable process.

title: The Mathematical Anatomy of Moving Averages:
subtitle: Advanced Trading, Deep Quantitative Insight, and Professional Applications
summary: The Mathematical Anatomy of Moving Averages treats moving averages as filters that estimate a slower market state rather than as predictive lines. Its visual explanations connect observed price, latent trend, noise, memory length, weighting schemes, responsiveness, smoothness, and lag. SMA, EMA, WMA, HMA, and adaptive ideas are compared through the signal-noise trade-off, convolution and weighting kernels, while causal versus centered averages expose look-ahead bias, repainting, and the difference between a beautiful historical line and a calculation that was actually available in real time.
target_audience: For technically minded traders, quantitative learners, and strategy developers who want to understand what moving averages actually compute.
seo_description: A quantitative visual guide to moving averages as filters, covering SMA, EMA, WMA, HMA, adaptive methods, lag, noise, convolution, causality, and look-ahead bias.
learning: Interpret moving averages as state estimates with explicit memory rather than prediction lines.
Compare filter length and weighting schemes through the trade-off between responsiveness and noise.
Understand convolution as the mathematical engine behind weighted moving averages.
Distinguish causal, live-usable averages from centered or future-dependent calculations.
Audit indicators for data provenance, real-time calculability, repainting, and informational delay.

title: Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia
subtitle: Panduan Visual Lengkap 120 Halaman untuk Kesiapsiagaan, Keselamatan, Tsunami & Pemulihan
summary:
Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia adalah sistem visual 120 langkah yang dirancang khusus untuk realitas kepulauan Indonesia—bukan terjemahan sederhana dari panduan negara lain. Buku ini menghubungkan ilmu gempa, kesiapsiagaan rumah dan keluarga, tindakan saat guncangan, keputusan tsunami, menit dan jam setelah gempa, 72 jam pertama, serta pemulihan awal. Konteksnya mencakup kota padat, desa, masyarakat pesisir, pulau kecil, rumah sederhana, apartemen, sekolah, pasar, sepeda motor, bus, kereta, feri dan pelabuhan ketika unsur tersebut benar-benar memengaruhi keputusan keselamatan.

Bagian awal membangun literasi risiko: sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, subduksi, gempa susulan, likuefaksi, longsor, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas dan risiko dijelaskan tanpa mengubah istilah seperti megathrust menjadi ramalan waktu. Bagian persiapan kemudian membawa pembaca ke rumah dan keluarga: mengamankan ruang, menilai bahaya nonstruktural, merencanakan titik temu dan rute, menyiapkan tas siaga, air, makanan, obat, dokumen dan kebutuhan khusus, serta menyimpan inventaris dan informasi penting. Nama dan sistem resmi seperti BMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB, BPBD, InfoBMKG, 112 dan 119 digunakan dengan batasan yang tepat dan kebutuhan verifikasi lokal bila layanan berbeda antardaerah.

Saat guncangan, buku memusatkan perhatian pada perlindungan kepala dan tubuh, menghindari lari massal ke pintu, dan menyesuaikan tindakan dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan dan transportasi. Karena Indonesia adalah negara kepulauan dengan banyak komunitas pesisir, tsunami mendapat bagian khusus: tanda alam, peringatan resmi, InaTEWS, keputusan untuk bergerak setelah aman dari guncangan, jalur lokal, kemacetan evakuasi, kebutuhan mobilitas, serta pilihan berjalan kaki atau berkendara berdasarkan rencana setempat. Bagian akhir membahas cedera dan bahaya langsung, keputusan keluar atau tetap, orang terjebak dan cara memberi sinyal, komunikasi, informasi resmi, 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi dan pemulihan bertahap. Tujuannya bukan menciptakan kepanikan, melainkan membuat keputusan penting lebih mudah diingat ketika waktu dan perhatian terbatas.
target_audience: Untuk warga dan pengunjung Indonesia; keluarga, penyewa, pemilik rumah, pelajar, pekerja, komuter, masyarakat pesisir, lansia, pengasuh, penyandang disabilitas, dan pelancong antarpulau yang membutuhkan sistem visual untuk bersiap sebelum gempa, bertindak saat guncangan, membuat keputusan tsunami, bertahan pada 72 jam pertama, dan memasuki pemulihan awal.
learning: Membedakan sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, bahaya, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas, dan risiko.
Memahami konteks subduksi dan gempa Indonesia tanpa mengubah istilah megathrust atau pola historis menjadi ramalan waktu.
Mengurangi bahaya nonstruktural di rumah dan mengetahui kapan penilaian struktur membutuhkan tenaga profesional.
Membangun rencana keluarga, titik temu, rute, tas siaga, persediaan air dan makanan, obat, dokumen, serta dukungan kebutuhan khusus.
Melakukan tindakan perlindungan saat guncangan dan menyesuaikannya dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan, dan ruang publik.
Memahami peran BMKG, InfoBMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB dan BPBD serta memverifikasi layanan darurat lokal seperti 112 bila diperlukan.
Mengenali bahwa tsunami adalah bahaya pesisir bersyarat dan menggabungkan tanda alam, peringatan resmi, serta rute evakuasi lokal.
Membuat keputusan evakuasi pantai tanpa menganggap berjalan kaki atau kendaraan selalu menjadi satu-satunya pilihan yang benar.
Menangani menit dan jam pertama setelah gempa: cedera, kebakaran, gas, kerusakan, gempa susulan, komunikasi, dan orang terjebak.
Menata 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi, dan pemulihan awal secara bertahap.
seo_description: Panduan visual 120 langkah untuk kesiapsiagaan gempa dan tsunami di Indonesia: risiko regional, rumah dan keluarga, tindakan saat guncangan, BMKG/InaTEWS, evakuasi pantai, 72 jam pertama, dan pemulihan.

title: AI APIs in Practice
subtitle: A Visual Engineering Guide to Multimodal AI, Agents, RAG, Evaluation, Governance, and Real-World Products
summary: AI APIs in Practice is a visual engineering guide to building with text, tool, retrieval, voice, video, and multimodal AI APIs. It breaks an API call into endpoint, authentication, payload, limits, request identity, and destination, then connects those mechanics to agents, RAG, evaluation, observability, governance, and production products. Security is treated as part of product design: secrets stay server-side, leaked credentials are rotated, least privilege and spend limits are applied, and payloads keep instructions, user data, constraints, and metadata clearly separated.
target_audience: For software engineers, AI builders, product developers, and technical learners building production-oriented AI systems.
seo_description: A visual engineering guide to AI APIs, multimodal systems, agents, RAG, secure authentication, payload design, evaluation, observability, and governance.
learning: Understand the roles of text, media, tool, retrieval, voice, and video APIs in an AI product.
Design reliable API requests with explicit endpoints, authentication, payloads, limits, and request IDs.
Protect API keys with server-side secret handling, rotation, least privilege, and environment separation.
Separate instructions, user data, constraints, and metadata for clearer model behavior.
Connect API mechanics to agents, RAG, evaluation, monitoring, audit, and real-world product design.

title: Mastering Support & Resistance
subtitle: 80 Practical Visual Infographics for Reading Levels, Entries, Exits, Breakouts, Retests, and Traps
summary: Mastering Support & Resistance is a visual guide to reading support and resistance as behavioral zones rather than perfect single-price lines. It develops demand and supply zones, liquidity references, role reversal after a breakout, bounce setups, breakout-and-retest structures, fake-breakout traps, wick-versus-body interpretation, repeated closes, round-number reactions, invalidation, position sizing, and journaling. The visual framework emphasizes confirmation and risk control instead of assuming that any marked level must hold.
target_audience: For visual price-action traders who want a practical framework for levels, reactions, breakouts, retests, and traps.
seo_description: A visual support and resistance guide covering zones, breakouts, retests, fakeouts, wick-versus-body confirmation, round numbers, entries, exits, and risk.
learning: Draw support and resistance as reaction zones rather than demanding exact-price precision.
Read rejection wicks, closes, repeated acceptance, and role reversal after breakouts.
Differentiate bounce, breakout-retest, and fake-breakout scenarios.
Use round numbers and liquidity references as context rather than automatic signals.
Define confirmation, invalidation, position size, and risk before committing capital.

title: Earthquake Survival in California
subtitle: A Complete 120-Page Visual Guide to Earthquake Preparedness, Safety & Recovery
summary:
Earthquake Survival in California is a 120-step visual preparedness, protective-action, and early-recovery system built specifically for California residents and visitors. It begins with earthquake science and local risk literacy—faults, shaking, ground failure, liquefaction, landslides, tsunami, buildings, and the correct use of hazard maps—while repeatedly separating hazard from a prediction of damage at a specific address. California geography, housing, coasts, freeways, Bay Area and Southern California contexts are used only when they change the decision, so the book remains a practical safety guide rather than a collection of landmarks or generic disaster posters.

The preparation sections move room by room and household by household. Readers learn how to reduce nonstructural hazards, distinguish what can be secured personally from what requires qualified structural assessment, protect important documents, build a home inventory, understand the general earthquake-insurance coverage gap, prepare a portable go-bag and stay-at-home supplies, plan water and food, maintain medications and medical devices, organize sanitation, prepare for power outages, and build family and accessibility-aware plans. Current California warning channels—including MyShake, Android Earthquake Alerts, Wireless Emergency Alerts, and the broader ShakeAlert ecosystem—are placed inside the larger rule that a warning is a cue for protective action, not a prediction tool.

The action and recovery sections cover Drop, Cover, and Hold On; bedrooms, high-rises, schools, workplaces, stores, outdoor spaces, freeways and other transportation contexts; coastal tsunami natural warnings; aftershocks; injury and household checks; fire, gas and electrical hazards; evacuation; communications; first 24–72-hour needs; damage documentation; cautious re-entry; professional assessment; and early recovery. The final master-reference pages compress the system into memorable before, during, after, 72-hour and recovery decisions. The book’s underlying message is practical rather than alarmist: uncertainty cannot be eliminated, but rehearsed decisions, safer spaces, reliable information, and prepared supplies can create better choices when time is short.
target_audience: For California residents and visitors, families, renters, homeowners, students, workers, commuters, older adults, caregivers, and people with disabilities who want a visual, California-specific system for understanding local earthquake risk, preparing the household, acting during shaking, and navigating the first 72 hours and early recovery.
learning: Understand California earthquake hazards without confusing hazard maps, regulatory zones, or historical patterns with address-specific damage predictions.
Reduce household nonstructural hazards while recognizing when structural assessment or retrofit design requires qualified professionals.
Prepare documents, home inventory, insurance questions, go-bags, stay-at-home supplies, water, food, medicines, sanitation, and backup power.
Set up and understand California earthquake warning channels such as MyShake, Android Earthquake Alerts, WEA, and ShakeAlert.
Apply Drop, Cover, and Hold On and adapt protective action to bedrooms, high-rises, schools, workplaces, stores, outdoors, and transportation.
Make safer driving decisions on California roads and freeways during and after shaking without assuming bridges or routes remain open.
Recognize tsunami as a conditional coastal hazard and respond to strong or long shaking and official or natural warnings appropriately.
Check people, fire, gas, electricity, building hazards, and aftershocks conservatively after shaking.
Plan the first 24–72 hours around water, information, shelter, communication, accessibility, and household continuity.
Document damage, approach re-entry cautiously, use qualified assessment, verify official assistance, and move into early recovery methodically.
seo_description: A California-specific 120-page visual earthquake guide covering local hazard literacy, home preparation, Drop Cover Hold On, ShakeAlert/MyShake warnings, tsunami safety, 72-hour supplies, utilities, insurance, transportation, and recovery.

title: Mavi Tikten Sonra
subtitle: İstanbul Aşkları — 1
summary:
Mavi Tikten Sonra, İstanbul Aşkları serisinin ilk romanıdır ve Defne'nin gece 02:17'de gönderdiği bir mesajın okunup cevapsız kalmasıyla açılır. İki mavi tik, sıradan bir telefon ayrıntısı olmaktan çıkıp bekleyişin, belirsizliğin ve bir ilişkinin içinde söylenmeyenlerin ağırlığını taşıyan merkeze dönüşür. Bölümler; 'Yazıyor…', kırk sekiz saat, iptal edilen buluşmalar, Pazar günleri, Karaköy'de yarım kalan bir gece ve çevrimiçi sessizlik gibi modern şehir ilişkilerinin küçük ama belirleyici anlarını izler.

Roman Defne ile Aras'ı yalnızca mesaj ekranında bırakmaz. On iki günlük mesafe ve cevapsızlığın ardından roller tersine döner; Aras'ın mesajı bu kez okunur ve bekleyen taraf o olur. Sonunda ikisi aynı masaya oturup niyetlerden önce yapılanları konuşmak, özrün arkasına saklanmadan yüzleşmek ve ilişkinin devam edip etmeyeceğini bir ekranın belirlemesine izin vermemek zorunda kalır. Kitap, dijital iletişimin hızına karşı gerçek konuşmanın yavaşlığını ve iki insanın yeniden birbirini duymayı öğrenmesini çağdaş İstanbul fonunda işler.
target_audience: Mesajlaşma çağındaki ilişkiler, İstanbul atmosferi, duygusal belirsizlik ve gerçekçi yüzleşmeler üzerine çağdaş romantik kurgu okumayı seven okurlar için.
learning: Dijital iletişimde görüldü bilgisi, bekleyiş ve sessizliğin ilişki üzerindeki duygusal ağırlığını izlemek.
Defne ve Aras'ın aynı olayları farklı zamanlarda ve farklı sorumluluk duygularıyla nasıl yaşadığını görmek.
Modern İstanbul ilişkilerinde mesaj, iptal, çevrimiçi olma ve yüz yüze konuşma arasındaki gerilimi takip etmek.
Niyet ile davranış arasındaki farkın ve özrün tek başına neden her şeyi düzeltmediğinin roman içindeki karşılığını görmek.
İlişkinin geleceğini telefon ekranından çıkarıp doğrudan konuşmaya taşıyan dönüşümü takip etmek.
seo_description: Faramarz Kowsari'nin İstanbul Aşkları serisinin ilk romanı: Defne ve Aras'ın mesajlar, sessizlik, bekleyiş, kırılma, yüzleşme ve yeniden konuşmayı öğrenme üzerinden ilerleyen çağdaş İstanbul ilişkisi.

title: Depremde Hayatta Kalma
subtitle: Türkiye ve İstanbul İçin Görsel Deprem Hazırlık, Güvenlik ve İlk İyileşme Rehberi
summary:
Depremde Hayatta Kalma, Türkiye’ye ve özellikle İstanbul’un yoğun apartman yaşamına göre tasarlanmış 120 adımlı görsel bir deprem hazırlık ve hayatta kalma sistemidir. Kitap, depremi korku görüntüleriyle değil, doğru kararları doğru zamanda verebilmek için anlaşılması gereken bir süreç olarak ele alır. İlk bölümlerde fay kırılması, sismik dalgalar, büyüklük–şiddet–yer hareketi ayrımı, Türkiye’nin tektonik bağlamı, Marmara, tehlike ile risk arasındaki fark, yerel zemin, büyütme, sıvılaşma, yamaç tehlikeleri ve kıyıda koşula bağlı tsunami riski açıklanır. Harita ve şemaların adres bazlı teşhis ya da deprem tahmini olmadığı özellikle korunur.

Hazırlık bölümleri ev içindeki yapısal olmayan tehlikeleri azaltma, oda oda güvenlik taraması, ağır eşyaları sabitleme, gaz–elektrik–su güvenliği sınırları, profesyonel yapı değerlendirmesinin rolü, aile iletişim planı, buluşma noktaları, e-Devlet ve resmî bilgi kanalları, afet çantası, su–gıda–ilaç–belge sürekliliği, çocuklar, yaşlılar, engelli bireyler, okul, işyeri ve apartman yönetimi gibi konuları bir araya getirir. İstanbul’a özgü sahnelerde apartmanlar, iki yakalı kent yapısı, toplu taşıma, Marmara kıyısı ve günlük hareketlilik yalnızca öğretici olduğunda kullanılır; amaç turistik bir İstanbul görüntüsü değil, gerçek karar ortamını görselleştirmektir.

Son bölüm yeniden giriş, hasar belgeleme, profesyonel değerlendirme, temel psikososyal sınırlar ve erken iyileşmeyi kapsar. Kitabın yaklaşımı nettir: depremi zamanlamak mümkün değildir; ancak ortamı, planı ve davranışı önceden hazırlamak mümkündür.
target_audience: Türkiye’de yaşayan veya bulunan aileler, apartman sakinleri, öğrenciler, çalışanlar, yaşlılar, bakım verenler, engelli bireyler, toplu taşıma kullanıcıları ve ziyaretçiler için; özellikle İstanbul’un yoğun kentsel yaşamında deprem öncesi, sarsıntı anı ve ilk 72 saat için görsel ve uygulanabilir bir karar sistemi isteyen okurlara yöneliktir.

Türkiye ve Marmara bağlamını anlamak ancak hiçbir harita ya da tarihsel örüntüyü kesin deprem tahmini gibi yorumlamamak.

title: Mikro Aldatma
subtitle: Modern Aşkın Sessiz İhanetleri
summary: Mikro Aldatma, modern ilişkilerde güveni büyük bir olaydan önce aşındırabilen küçük ama tekrarlanan davranışları inceler. Telefon, mesajlar, beğeniler, eski partnerler, iş ilişkileri, sınırlar, itiraf, onarım, duygusal ilişki, kalmak ya da ayrılmak gibi alanları ele alırken amacı gözetim değil, daha açık bir dil ve daha dürüst sınırlar kurmaktır.
target_audience: Modern ilişkilerde güven, sınır, dijital davranış ve duygusal sadakat üzerine daha net düşünmek isteyen okurlar için.

Onarımın mümkün olduğu durumlarla ayrılmanın daha sağlıklı olabileceği örüntüleri ayırt etmek.

title: Silmenin Gücü
subtitle: Hayatını Yoran Şeyleri Çıkararak Huzuru, Netliği ve İç Özgürlüğü Geri Kazanmak
summary: Silmenin Gücü, hayatı sadeleştirmeyi sertlik ya da intikam olarak değil, huzuru tekrar tekrar bozan erişimleri, alışkanlıkları ve içsel döngüleri bilinçli biçimde azaltmak olarak ele alır. Amaç, insanları cezalandırmak değil, kurulmakta olan hayatı sürekli yaralayan şeylere sınırsız erişim vermemektir.

İnsanların, alışkanlıkların ve dijital gürültünün gizli maliyetini fark etmek.
Aile, aşk, arkadaşlık ve işte daha temiz sınırlar kurmak.
Suçluluk ile öz-koruma arasındaki farkı ayırt etmek.
Çıkarılan şeylerin ardından daha sakin ve tutarlı bir hayat inşa etmek.

title: Let Karma Handle It
subtitle: A Cosmic Law of Return for Peace, Joy, Prosperity, and Life Beyond Revenge
summary: Let Karma Handle It reframes karma as a language of return and balance rather than a threat, superstition, or excuse for passivity. Its practical concern is what happens when a person stops spending attention on revenge, proving, surveillance, and the wish to administer consequences personally. Across themes of betrayal, anger, boundaries, silence, forgiveness, prosperity, joy, and a thirty-day practice map, the book asks the reader to protect conduct and energy without becoming an assistant to punishment.
target_audience: For readers trying to move beyond betrayal, resentment, or revenge without surrendering boundaries or self-respect.
seo_description: A reflective practical guide to karma, revenge, betrayal, boundaries, forgiveness, peace, prosperity, and reclaiming energy from the need to punish.
learning: Separate karma from threats, magical thinking, and passive avoidance.
Recognize the attention and energy cost of revenge and constant proof-seeking.
Use boundaries and distance without turning them into punishment theatre.
Distinguish forgiveness from renewed access or denial of harm.
Build a life organized around conduct, peace, joy, and forward movement.

title: Kendini Açıklamayı Bırak

summary: Kendini Açıklamayı Bırak, gerekli açıklama, sorumluluk ve onarım ile insanın varlığını sürekli savunma dosyasına çevirmesi arasındaki farkı inceler. Kitap, anlaşılma açlığını, fazla açıklama alışkanlığını, aile rollerini, aşkı, işi, parayı, sosyal medya yargısını, temiz bir 'hayır' demeyi ve sessizliğin güçten doğduğu anları ele alır. Amaç daha az konuşmak değil; her yanlış anlaşılmada kendini mahkemeye çıkarmaktan vazgeçmektir.
target_audience: Sürekli yanlış anlaşılmaktan, kendini kanıtlamaktan ve başkalarının yargılarına cevap yetiştirmekten yorulan okurlar için.
seo_description: Fazla açıklama, onay arayışı, sınırlar, temiz hayır, sosyal medya yargısı ve başkalarının fikirleri karşısında özsaygıyı koruma üzerine bir rehber.

Anlaşılma ihtiyacının ne zaman öz-erimeye dönüştüğünü fark etmek.
İsteksiz dinleyiciler ve bitmeyen tartışmalarda açıklama döngüsünü sonlandırmak.
Aile, aşk, iş ve sosyal medyada daha temiz sınırlar kullanmak.
Sessizliği kaçış olarak değil, gerektiğinde bilinçli bir seçim olarak kurmak.

title: Wealth Begins Where You Stop Selling Yourself Cheap
subtitle: How to Stop Undervaluing Your Time, Talent, Presence, and Life
summary: Wealth Begins Where You Stop Selling Yourself Cheap treats wealth as more than money and asks where a life is being quietly discounted before a price is ever named. It connects undercharging with over-explaining, unclear scope, fear of losing clients, exhausted availability, hidden talent, self-erasure in love, weak boundaries, scattered attention, and the body's record of depletion. The book also insists that apprenticeship is not humiliation and that higher prices must be supported by skill, proof, ethical value, and clean exchange rather than entitlement. Later chapters examine attention as a form of salary, panic in the marketplace, leaving without bitterness, and the difference between becoming expensive in image and accurate in life. A thirty-day repricing plan moves through observing leaks, keeping one boundary, strengthening one proof of skill, and making one cleaner exchange so self-respect becomes visible behavior rather than theory.
target_audience: For freelancers, professionals, creators, business owners, and readers who repeatedly underprice their work, overgive time or emotional labor, struggle to state boundaries, or want a more ethical and evidence-based relationship with personal value.
seo_description: A practical guide to self-worth, pricing, boundaries, skill, proof, attention, relationships, ethical value, and a 30-day plan for stopping the habit of selling your time and presence cheap.
learning: Recognize the nonfinancial ways a person can discount time, talent, attention, body, and presence.
Separate healthy apprenticeship from chronic underpricing or self-erasure.
Use clearer scope, boundaries, terms, and exchanges instead of fear-driven availability.
Support higher fees with stronger craft, proof, testimonials, and easier-to-understand value.
Notice how panic, over-explaining, and fear of losing a client weaken bargaining behavior.
Apply the same value logic to relationships without turning self-respect into hardness.
Treat attention and energy as scarce assets that deserve deliberate allocation.
Use a 30-day plan to turn value from an idea into repeated observable behavior.

title: Zihnin Ona Ad Vermeden Önce

summary: Zihnin Ona Ad Vermeden Önce, mindfulness'ı zorla sakinleşmek olarak değil, olay ile zihnin o olaya verdiği isim ve hikâye arasındaki küçük aralığı görebilmek olarak ele alır. Güvenlik sınırlarını koruyarak okuyucuyu 'isimsiz alan'a, yani tepkinin otomatikleşmeden önce gözlemlenebildiği yere geri çağırır.
target_audience: Sakinleşmeye çalıştıkça daha çok zorlanan ve mindfulness'ı günlük hayatın gerçek anlarında kullanmak isteyen okurlar için.
seo_description: Olay ile zihnin hikâyesi arasındaki aralığı görmek; kaygı, öfke, beden, belirsizlik, dikkat ve dijital gürültüyle çalışmak için mindfulness rehberi.
learning: Olan şey ile zihin tarafından eklenen yorumları birbirinden ayırmak.
Beden sinyallerini otomatik hikâyeden önce fark etmek.
Kaygı, öfke, utanç ve yasla sakinliği zorlamadan çalışmak.
Bildirimler, mesajlar ve dikkat dağınıklığı karşısında farkındalık geliştirmek.
Kısa geri dönüş protokolleriyle olay ve tepki arasındaki alanı büyütmek.

title: Servet, Kendini Ucuza Satmayı Bıraktığın Yerde Başlar
subtitle: Zamanını, Yeteneğini, Varlığını ve Hayatını Değerinin Altında Vermeyi Bırakmak
summary: Servet, Kendini Ucuza Satmayı Bıraktığın Yerde Başlar, serveti yalnızca para olarak değil; zaman, yetenek, dikkat, beden, sınır ve yaşam alanı olarak ele alır. Çıraklık ile aşağılanmayı, etik değer ile gösterişli fiyatı, beceri ile kanıtı birbirinden ayırır. Son bölümler dikkat ekonomisini, piyasa paniğini, nefret etmeden ayrılmayı ve otuz günlük yeniden fiyatlandırma planını işler: sızıntıları gözlemek, bir sınırı korumak, bir beceri kanıtını güçlendirmek ve daha temiz bir alışveriş yapmak.
target_audience: İşini düşük fiyatlayan, zamanını veya duygusal emeğini fazla veren, sınır koymakta zorlanan ya da kişisel değerle daha temiz ve kanıta dayalı bir ilişki kurmak isteyen serbest çalışanlar, profesyoneller, yaratıcılar ve genel okurlar için.
seo_description: Özdeğer, ücret, sınırlar, beceri, kanıt, dikkat, ilişkiler, etik değer ve zamanı ile varlığını ucuza vermeyi bırakmak için 30 günlük uygulama planı.
learning: Zamanı, yeteneği, dikkati, bedeni ve varlığı ucuza vermenin finans dışı biçimlerini fark etmek.
