Panik ve müşteriyi kaybetme korkusunun pazarlık davranışını nasıl zayıflattığını görmek.
Özdeğer mantığını ilişkilerde sertleşmeden uygulamak.
Dikkat ve enerjiyi sınırlı varlıklar olarak korumak.
Otuz günlük planla değeri teori olmaktan çıkarıp gözlenebilir davranışa dönüştürmek.

title: La segunda riqueza
subtitle: Guía práctica para generar ingresos con inteligencia artificial después de los 50
summary: La segunda riqueza es una guía práctica para personas con experiencia que quieren convertir criterio, conocimientos, relaciones, reputación y reconocimiento de patrones en servicios, productos y sistemas apoyados por inteligencia artificial. El libro evita las promesas de dinero rápido y empieza por el margen real de tiempo y dinero, la experiencia utilizable, los límites de la IA generativa, la elección de mercado, la privacidad y la necesidad de trabajar con evidencia. Después desarrolla la escucha del mercado, los problemas caros, la selección de camino, el trabajo en plataformas, los servicios empaquetados, las evaluaciones para pequeñas empresas, los activos digitales, las microherramientas, el precio, la prospección, los procedimientos y la automatización posterior a la prueba. La parte de laboratorios obliga a producir objetos reales: una muestra de servicio, edición y ghostwriting, contenido para negocio local, una página de aterrizaje, una evaluación de oportunidades de IA, un producto digital, un motor de contenido o una herramienta de una sola función. El plan final de noventa días convierte el aprendizaje en entrevistas, muestras, pilotos, entregas, pruebas, procedimientos y decisiones basadas en evidencia. Los veinte apéndices reúnen hojas de trabajo, entrevistas, scorecards, ofertas, precios, mensajes, propuestas, controles de privacidad, SOP y paneles de seguimiento.
key_topics: Ingresos con IA después de los 50
Problemas caros y validación de mercado
target_audience: Para profesionales con experiencia, personas en transición laboral, consultores, educadores, autónomos y mayores de 50 que desean combinar su experiencia con herramientas de IA de forma práctica, prudente y basada en evidencia.
seo_description: Guía práctica para mayores de 50 que quieren transformar experiencia en servicios, productos e ingresos asistidos por IA mediante validación de mercado, clientes, precios, automatización y un plan de 90 días.
learning: Hacer visible el valor económico acumulado en experiencia, criterio, relaciones y reconocimiento de patrones.
Construir un margen realista de dinero, tiempo y energía antes de elegir un camino de ingresos.
Usar la IA generativa como aprendiz rápido que necesita revisión y límites.
Elegir un mercado y un problema valioso mediante entrevistas, señales y evidencia.
Convertir experiencia en servicios, evaluaciones, activos digitales, sistemas de contenido o pequeñas herramientas.
Definir alcance, precio, privacidad, aprobación humana y medidas de éxito antes de automatizar.
Validar la demanda con muestras, contactos, conversaciones y pilotos reales.
Documentar la entrega, crear procedimientos y automatizar solamente después de demostrar utilidad.
Aplicar el plan de noventa días y los apéndices para producir pruebas externas y decisiones claras.

title: The Second Wealth
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Building AI-Powered Income After 50
summary: The Second Wealth is a practical manual for experienced adults who want to turn accumulated judgment, knowledge, relationships, reputation, and pattern recognition into modern services, products, and systems supported by AI. It rejects instant-income promises and begins with runway, usable experience, the limits of generative AI, customer selection, privacy, and evidence. The book then moves through market listening, expensive-problem discovery, path selection, platform work, packaged services, assessments, digital assets, micro-tools, pricing, outreach, SOPs, automation, and ownership. Part Five uses hands-on laboratories for services, writing, local-business content, landing pages, AI opportunity assessments, digital products, content engines, and one-function tools. The final ninety-day plan moves from choosing a market and building one sample to customer conversations, paid pilots, delivery, documentation, pricing, a first SOP, and a low-risk automation. Twenty practical appendices provide readiness checks, scorecards, interview guides, offer cards, pricing sheets, outreach patterns, proposal and SOP templates, privacy checks, and a ninety-day dashboard.
key_topics: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Notebook workflows
Platform work and AI evaluation jobs
target_audience: For experienced professionals, retirees, career changers, consultants, managers, educators, and adults over 50 who want a realistic, evidence-based way to combine decades of experience with modern AI tools without relying on hype, guaranteed-income claims, or unnecessary technical complexity.
seo_description: A practical guide for adults over 50 to turn experience into AI-assisted services, products, and second-income systems through market testing, customer discovery, pricing, automation, and a 90-day evidence plan.
learning: Identify the economic value hidden inside accumulated experience, judgment, relationships, and pattern recognition.
Build a realistic financial and time runway before choosing an AI-assisted income path.
Use generative AI as a checked apprentice rather than as an unquestioned authority.
Select one market and one expensive problem through interviews, evidence, and a path-selection matrix.
Turn expertise into packaged services, assessments, digital assets, content systems, or small decision tools.
Price and scope offers with clear boundaries, measurable outcomes, and respect for privacy and professional limits.
Test demand through samples, outreach, discovery calls, paid pilots, and explicit decision records.
Document repeatable delivery, automate only after proof, and build toward owned assets and a resilient second-income system.
Use the ninety-day plan and practical appendices to convert learning into external evidence rather than endless preparation.

title: España ante el calor
category: Hogar, clima y calidad del aire
subtitle: Guía visual para una vivienda fresca, saludable y eficiente
summary:
España ante el calor es una guía visual de 100 páginas concebida específicamente para viviendas, climas y rutinas de España. No es una traducción literal de una guía internacional: reconstruye la lógica térmica y de calidad del aire con terminología de España, unidades métricas, euros cuando son necesarios, pisos, áticos, patios, balcones, persianas, toldos y situaciones reales de vivienda. El recorrido parte de una idea sencilla pero decisiva: la casa funciona como un sistema térmico. El calor entra, se genera, se almacena, se desplaza y debe salir; por eso comprender radiación, conducción, convección, inercia térmica, humedad, movimiento del aire, noches tropicales, isla de calor urbana y microclima permite elegir mejor antes de gastar dinero en una solución.

La parte práctica enseña a construir el perfil térmico de la vivienda y a leer orientación, recorrido solar, ventanas, vidrio, cubierta, fachadas, aislamiento, puentes térmicos, infiltraciones, distribución interior y fuentes de calor. A partir de ese diagnóstico se desarrolla una estrategia por capas: primero controlar la ganancia solar con sombra exterior, toldos, persianas, cortinas, películas solares, superficies adecuadas y soluciones compatibles con viviendas de alquiler; después decidir cuándo abrir o cerrar, cómo aprovechar ventilación cruzada, ventilación nocturna, ventiladores, deshumidificación, refrigeración por zonas y aire acondicionado sin convertir una regla útil en una receta universal. El libro rota deliberadamente entre calor seco del interior, calor extremo andaluz, humedad mediterránea, humedad atlántica y noches muy cálidas.

La guía también integra un problema que a menudo se separa del calor: la calidad del aire. Explica cómo decidir entre ventilar para refrescar o cerrar frente a contaminación, PM2,5, PM10, calima, polvo sahariano o humo de incendios; aborda purificadores, caudal de aire limpio, una habitación prioritaria de aire limpio, CO₂ como pista de ventilación y el efecto de cocinar sobre partículas, humedad y temperatura. Las últimas páginas conectan confort, factura eléctrica, demanda de refrigeración, mantenimiento, cortes de suministro y planificación diaria. El objetivo no es imponer una temperatura o un aparato, sino dar al lector un sistema visual para observar su vivienda, comparar condiciones y tomar decisiones más frescas, saludables y eficientes según su clima y su edificio.
target_audience: Para personas que viven en España —en pisos, áticos, viviendas interiores, casas costeras o viviendas en zonas de calor seco— y quieren comprender por qué se sobrecalienta su hogar, cómo combinar sombra, ventilación y refrigeración, y cómo proteger simultáneamente el confort, la calidad del aire y el consumo energético.
learning: Entender la vivienda como un sistema conectado de calor, aire, humedad y almacenamiento térmico.
Reconocer cómo radiación, conducción, convección, infiltraciones y fuentes internas contribuyen al sobrecalentamiento.
Construir un perfil térmico básico de la vivienda antes de elegir medidas de refrigeración.
Priorizar sombra, persianas, toldos y control solar según orientación, ventanas, cubierta y fachada.
Decidir cuándo abrir o cerrar ventanas comparando temperatura, humedad, calidad del aire, viento, ruido, seguridad y hora del día.
Combinar ventilación cruzada, ventilación nocturna, ventiladores, deshumidificación y refrigeración mecánica según el contexto.
Adaptar decisiones a calor seco interior, calor andaluz, humedad mediterránea o atlántica y noches tropicales.
Responder a calima, polvo sahariano, contaminación y humo equilibrando refrigeración, ventilación y filtración.
Relacionar tamaño de estancia, filtración, caudal de aire limpio, ubicación, ruido y mantenimiento de purificadores.
Conectar confort térmico con consumo, factura eléctrica, mantenimiento, resiliencia y un plan diario adaptable.
seo_description: Guía visual de 100 páginas para afrontar el calor en viviendas de España: sombra, ventilación, persianas, toldos, refrigeración, humedad, calima, humo, calidad del aire, consumo energético y decisiones adaptadas al clima.

title: İkinci Servet
subtitle: 50 Yaşından Sonra Yapay Zekâ ile Gelir Oluşturmanın Uygulamalı Rehberi
summary: İkinci Servet, yıllar içinde birikmiş muhakeme, bilgi, ilişki, itibar ve örüntü tanıma becerisini modern yapay zekâ araçlarıyla hizmete, ürüne ve sisteme dönüştürmek isteyen deneyimli yetişkinler için uygulamalı bir rehberdir. Kitap hızlı zenginlik vaadi sunmaz; önce zaman ve para pistini, kullanılabilir deneyimi, üretken yapay zekânın sınırlarını, pazar seçimini, mahremiyeti ve kanıt disiplinini kurar. Ardından pahalı sorunları bulma, müşteriyle konuşma, yol seçimi, platform işi, paketli hizmet, işletme değerlendirmesi, dijital varlık, mikro araç, fiyatlandırma, ilk yirmi kapı, keşif görüşmeleri, SOP, kanıttan sonra otomasyon ve sahip olunan varlıklara geçiş üzerinde ilerler. Beşinci bölümde hizmet, yazı ve editörlük, yerel işletme içeriği, açılış sayfası, AI fırsat değerlendirmesi, dijital ürün, içerik motoru ve tek işlevli araç laboratuvarları vardır. Son doksan günlük plan seçimden örnek üretmeye, pazara çıkmaya, ilk teslimata, süreci belgelemeye ve tekrar edilebilir bir gelir sistemine doğru ilerler. Uygulama ekleri; hazırlık testleri, deneyim envanteri, sorun puan kartı, müşteri görüşmesi, teklif kartı, fiyatlandırma, mesaj örnekleri, teklif ve SOP şablonları, mahremiyet kontrolü ve doksan günlük panel sağlar.
target_audience: Deneyimli profesyoneller, emekliler, kariyer değiştirenler, danışmanlar, yöneticiler, eğitmenler ve 50 yaş üstünde yılların deneyimini yapay zekâ araçlarıyla gerçekçi ve kanıta dayalı bir ikinci gelir sistemine dönüştürmek isteyen okurlar için.
seo_description: 50 yaşından sonra deneyimi yapay zekâ destekli hizmet, ürün ve ikinci gelir sistemine dönüştürmek için pazar doğrulama, müşteri görüşmeleri, fiyatlandırma, otomasyon ve 90 günlük uygulama rehberi.
learning: Deneyim, muhakeme, ilişki ve örüntü tanıma içinde saklı ekonomik değeri görünür kılmak.
Bir gelir yolunu seçmeden önce gerçekçi zaman, para ve enerji pistini hesaplamak.
Üretken yapay zekâyı denetlenmesi gereken hızlı bir çırak gibi kullanmak.
Müşteri görüşmeleri, sinyaller ve kanıtla bir pazar ve değerli sorun seçmek.
Deneyimi paketli hizmete, değerlendirmeye, dijital varlığa, içerik sistemine veya küçük araca dönüştürmek.
Fiyat, kapsam, mahremiyet, insan onayı ve başarı ölçüsünü otomasyondan önce tanımlamak.
Örnekler, erişim mesajları, keşif görüşmeleri ve pilotlarla gerçek talebi test etmek.
Tekrarlanabilir teslimi belgelemek ve yalnız kanıtlandıktan sonra düşük riskli otomasyon kurmak.
Doksan günlük plan ve uygulama ekleriyle öğrenmeyi dış dünyada ölçülebilir kanıta çevirmek.

title: Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre
subtitle: Mindfulness para los momentos en que la calma no llega
summary: Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre presenta el mindfulness como la capacidad de ver el espacio entre un hecho y la historia que la mente construye sobre él, no como una obligación de sentirse tranquilo. El libro explora cuerpo, memoria, ansiedad, ira, vergüenza, duelo, incertidumbre, silencio, mensajes, notificaciones, aburrimiento y distracción. Su hilo conductor es el «espacio sin nombre»: el instante en que todavía es posible observar antes de convertir una sensación en una identidad, un juicio o una reacción automática.
target_audience: Para lectores que buscan una práctica de mindfulness realista para momentos en los que la calma no aparece por voluntad.
seo_description: Mindfulness para distinguir hechos de historias mentales y trabajar con ansiedad, ira, cuerpo, incertidumbre, silencio y distracción cuando la calma no llega.
learning: Distinguir lo que ocurrió de la interpretación automática que aparece después.
Reconocer señales corporales antes de que se conviertan en una historia completa.
Trabajar con ansiedad, ira, vergüenza y duelo sin forzar una calma artificial.
Observar el efecto de mensajes, notificaciones y distracción sobre la atención.
Practicar pequeños retornos al espacio anterior al nombre y a la reacción.

title: The Published Works of Faramarz Kowsari
subtitle: Verified Bibliography & Authorship Portfolio
summary: The Published Works of Faramarz Kowsari is an authorship portfolio designed to make a Persian-language publishing record accessible to international professional readers. It consolidates ISBN-registered publications and records associated with the National Library and Archives of Iran, explains an editorial transparency method for reconstructed English titles and synopses, documents de-duplication by ISBN and record identifiers, preserves author order, and provides verification links where available. The selected edition organizes archival works across technology and AI, business, education, psychology and mindfulness, personal development, relationships, and creative literature.
key_topics: National Library and Archives of Iran
target_audience: For employers, academic partners, media organizations, professional reviewers, and readers who need an English-accessible overview of Faramarz Kowsari's documented publishing record.
seo_description: Verified bibliography and authorship portfolio of Faramarz Kowsari, consolidating Iranian ISBN and National Library records with verification methodology and archival context.
learning: Understand the scope and verification method used to assemble the authorship portfolio.
Read reconstructed English synopses as editorial descriptions rather than verbatim publisher abstracts.
Use ISBN and National Library record identifiers to distinguish and verify archival entries.
See how duplicate records and author order are handled in the portfolio.
Navigate a publishing history spanning technology, business, education, psychology, relationships, and literature.

title: Before Your Mind Names It
subtitle: Mindfulness for the Moments When Calm Does Not Come
summary: Before Your Mind Names It treats mindfulness as the ability to notice the interval between an event and the name, judgment, or story the mind gives it. Rather than demanding calm, the book works with body signals, memory, anxiety, anger, shame, grief, uncertainty, silence, messages, notifications, boredom, distraction, and the temptation to use meditation as escape. Its recurring practice is to return to the unnamed space where experience can be observed before reaction becomes identity.
target_audience: For readers who want mindfulness that remains usable during emotionally noisy moments rather than only when calm is already present.
seo_description: A practical mindfulness guide to the space between experience and interpretation, covering body awareness, anxiety, anger, uncertainty, digital distraction, and return practices.
learning: Separate observable events from the stories and labels that rapidly follow them.
Notice body signals before they are absorbed into automatic interpretations.
Work with anxiety, anger, shame, grief, and uncertainty without forcing calm.
Recognize when meditation or distraction is being used to avoid experience.
Use short return practices to widen the space between stimulus and response.

title: SQL for Data Analysis
subtitle: A Visual, Practical Guide with Real Business Projects, Interview Problems, CTEs, Window Functions, Dashboards, and Portfolio Workflows
summary: SQL for Data Analysis is a visual, practice-oriented path from relational foundations to portfolio-ready analytics. It covers database structure, schema design, SELECT queries, filtering, sorting, joins, aggregation, data types, import and export, constraints and integrity, DDL and DML, transactions, CTEs, subqueries, views, temporary logic, window functions, ranking, interview problems, projects, optimization, and business interpretation. The book is dialect-aware and repeatedly emphasizes safe execution: destructive statements are tested in controlled environments, rows are verified, transactions are used, and SELECT comes before change.
target_audience: For aspiring data analysts, data scientists, business analysts, and developers who want practical SQL skills tied to real analytical work.
seo_description: A visual SQL guide from relational foundations and joins to CTEs, window functions, interview problems, business projects, optimization, dashboards, and portfolio work.
learning: Build a reliable relational foundation with tables, keys, schemas, and relationships.
Write clean queries using filtering, sorting, joins, grouping, aggregation, CTEs, and windows.
Handle data types, imports, constraints, integrity, DDL, DML, and transactions safely.
Interpret query results as business evidence rather than stopping at syntax.
Practice interview patterns, real projects, optimization, and portfolio delivery across SQL dialects.

title: Stop Explaining Yourself
subtitle: How to Leave the Courtroom of Other People's Opinions
summary: Stop Explaining Yourself examines the difference between responsible explanation and compulsive self-defense. It follows the urge to be understood through family roles, relationships, work, money, social media, boundaries, and the endless internal courtroom where every choice seems to require a case. The book does not argue for silence or avoidance of accountability; it asks when explanation stops clarifying and starts erasing the person who is explaining.
target_audience: For readers exhausted by proving, defending, and translating themselves to people whose judgment has become an internal courtroom.
seo_description: A practical guide to over-explaining, approval seeking, boundaries, clean refusals, social judgment, and leaving the courtroom of other people's opinions.
learning: Distinguish useful explanation from compulsive self-justification.
Recognize when the hunger to be understood becomes self-erasure.
Stop feeding arguments with people who are unwilling to listen in good faith.
Use cleaner boundaries in family, love, work, and online spaces.
Choose silence deliberately when more explanation would not create clarity.

title: Deja de explicarte
subtitle: Cómo salir del tribunal de las opiniones ajenas
summary: Deja de explicarte examina la diferencia entre una explicación necesaria y la defensa compulsiva de la propia existencia. El libro sigue la necesidad de ser comprendido a través de la familia, el amor, el trabajo, el dinero, las redes sociales, los límites y el hábito de convertir cada decisión en un expediente. No propone dejar de asumir responsabilidades; propone reconocer cuándo explicar aclara y cuándo solo prolonga un juicio que no terminará con más palabras.
target_audience: Para personas cansadas de justificarse, demostrar su valor y vivir pendientes de la opinión ajena.
seo_description: Guía práctica sobre sobreexplicación, necesidad de aprobación, límites, redes sociales y cómo salir del tribunal de las opiniones ajenas.
learning: Distinguir una explicación útil de una justificación compulsiva.
Reconocer cuándo la necesidad de ser comprendido termina borrando la propia posición.
Dejar de alimentar discusiones con oyentes que no buscan comprender.
Usar límites más limpios en familia, amor, trabajo y espacios digitales.
Elegir el silencio cuando añadir palabras ya no añade claridad.

title: Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home
summary:
Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home is a 100-page visual handbook built around one practical idea: a home is a connected heat-and-air system, not a collection of unrelated devices. The book begins by showing how heat enters, is generated, is stored, moves through materials and air, and eventually must leave. Radiation, conduction, convection, thermal mass, humidity, air movement, hot nights, urban heat islands, and the microclimate outside a particular window are translated into household-scale diagrams so readers can diagnose why a room or dwelling becomes uncomfortable before buying a solution.

The middle of the book turns diagnosis into layered action. It examines window orientation and glass, roofs, walls, insulation, thermal bridges, leakage, room layout, internal heat sources, balconies and top-floor conditions, then develops a shade-first strategy using external shading, interior blinds and curtains, solar-control films, reflective surfaces, trees, cool roofs, and rental-friendly measures. Ventilation is treated as a decision rather than a ritual: cross-ventilation, single-sided ventilation, stack effect, night flushing, fan placement, ceiling fans, evaporative cooling, dehumidification, zone cooling, air-conditioning types and sizing, thermostat strategy, portable units, maintenance, and smart controls are compared according to context.

Heat is only half the indoor-environment problem, so the later pages connect cooling to air quality and energy. The book covers outdoor pollution, PM2.5, wildfire smoke, the trade-off between opening windows for cooling and closing them for cleaner air, air purifiers, clean-air rooms, CO₂ as a ventilation clue, cooking particles and moisture, condensation and mold risk, electricity bills, cooling demand, cost-versus-impact decisions, and power-outage strategies. Illustrative household scenarios—including Mediterranean and humid coastal homes—show how the pieces interact, and the final action planning converts the whole system into a practical 24-hour routine that changes with sun, temperature, humidity, air quality, and household needs.
target_audience: For renters and homeowners, apartment residents, households facing hot summers or heat waves, people balancing cooling with indoor-air concerns, and non-specialist readers who want a practical visual framework for making their home cooler, cleaner, and more energy-aware without assuming one solution fits every building or climate.
learning: Read a home as a heat-and-air system and identify how radiation, conduction, convection, internal gains, storage, and leakage interact.
Build a simple home heat profile using orientation, windows, roof, walls, insulation, layout, occupancy, and local microclimate.
Prioritize shading and solar control before relying only on mechanical cooling.
Decide when ventilation can help by comparing indoor and outdoor temperature, humidity, air quality, wind, noise, security, and time of day.
Use cross-ventilation, night flushing, fans, ceiling fans, zone cooling, and other low-energy strategies in the right context.
Understand the roles and limitations of evaporative cooling, dehumidification, portable air conditioners, and correctly sized cooling systems.
Balance heat relief with PM2.5, wildfire smoke, outdoor pollution, filtration, and clean-air-room strategies.
Use CO₂ as a ventilation clue without treating it as a universal measure of every indoor pollutant.
Connect cooling choices to electricity use, maintenance, cost, resilience, and power-outage planning.
Create a 24-hour household heat plan that changes as conditions change rather than following one fixed rule.
seo_description: A 100-page visual home guide to extreme heat, thermal comfort, shading, ventilation, fans, air conditioning, smoke and PM2.5, indoor air quality, cooling costs, power outages, and practical heat-safe household decisions.

title: Bırak Gitsin, Ama Sen Kendinden Gitme
subtitle: Kalmayı Seçmeyen Birinden Kendi Varlığını Terk Etmeden Nasıl Geçilir
summary: Bırak Gitsinler, Ama Sen Kendinden Gitme; bir insanın, işin, dostluğun, şehrin, rolün ya da hayalin gidişinden sonra kişinin kendi hayatından da uzaklaşmamasını anlatır. Kitap gidenleri düşmanlaştırmaz; okuru bedenine, onuruna, zamanına, uykusuna, işine ve geleceğine geri çağırır. Yirmi bir bölüm boyunca vedasız gidişler, açıklama ihtiyacı, tutunma, sessizce yalvarma, boş yeri taşıma, bedene dönüş, hayatı bekleme modundan çıkarma, boş alanla kalma, yarayı tahta oturtmama, acıya ihanet etmeden neşeye izin verme ve giden kişiyi yeniden gerçek ölçüsüne indirme üzerinde durur. Ana fikir, başkasının gidişini yönetmeye çalışmak yerine kendi varlığını terk etmemektir.
target_audience: Ayrılık, uzaklaşan bir dostluk, biten bir iş, taşınma, kapanan bir rol ya da yarım kalan bir gelecek sonrasında kendine geri dönmek isteyen okurlar için.
seo_description: Ayrılık, vedasız gidiş, beden, özsaygı, bekleme modu, açıklama ihtiyacı, sınırlar, neşe ve kendi hayatına geri dönmek üzerine pratik bir rehber.
learning: Bir gidişin resmi bir vedadan önce davranışlarda nasıl görünür hâle geldiğini fark etmek.
Giden kişinin seçimini kendi değerinin nihai hükmü hâline getirmemek.
Cevapsız soruları sonsuz bir iç mahkemeye dönüştürmeden gerçekle kalabilmek.
Beden, uyku, iş, para, arkadaşlık ve günlük düzen üzerinden kendi hayatına geri dönmek.
Boşluğu ve acıyı inkâr etmeden onların hayatın tamamını yönetmesine izin vermemek.
Öfke ya da küçümseme yerine küçük ve görünür özsadakatlerle geleceği yeniden kurmak.

title: Linear Regression in Machine Learning and Data Science
subtitle: From Fundamentals to Real-World Applications
summary: Linear Regression in Machine Learning and Data Science is a visual path from intuition to implementation. It introduces simple and multiple linear regression, the best-fit line, coefficients, residuals, error measures, and least-squares reasoning before moving into data preparation, assumptions, diagnostics, regularization, multicollinearity, Python implementation, case studies, interpretation, and communication. Its recurring learning flow combines definitions, formulas, warnings, examples, code, outputs, and takeaways so that mathematical ideas remain connected to actual modeling decisions.
target_audience: For students, analysts, data scientists, machine-learning learners, and practitioners who want regression explained visually and implemented practically.
seo_description: A visual guide to linear regression covering intuition, least squares, diagnostics, regularization, Python, real-world case studies, and model interpretation.
learning: Build intuition for simple and multiple linear regression before relying on formulas.
Understand coefficients, residuals, least squares, and common error measures.
Prepare data and diagnose assumptions, outliers, multicollinearity, and overfitting.
Use regularization and model-improvement methods appropriately.
Implement, interpret, communicate, and apply regression models in Python and real projects.

title: Aynadaki Canavar
subtitle: Korku Başkalarının Yüzünü Kararttığında Hakikati Yeniden Görmek
summary: Aynadaki Canavar, korku ve yargının başka insanları zihnimizde nasıl tek boyutlu 'canavarlar'a dönüştürebildiğini inceler. Kitap tehlikeyi inkâr etmeyi ya da sınırları kaldırmayı savunmaz; olgularla korku hikâyesini, ayırt etmeyle şeytanlaştırmayı, öz-korumayla projeksiyonu birbirinden ayırmaya çalışır. On dört bölüm ve yirmi bir günlük ayna pratiği; dedikodu, ödünç alınmış korkular, acı, yargı, duraklama, kendi karanlık yanımız ve yeniden insan yüzünü görebilme kapasitesi üzerinde çalışır.
target_audience: Korku, öfke ve yargının insan algısını nasıl değiştirdiğini anlamak isteyen özfarkındalık ve psikoloji okurları için.
seo_description: Korku, yargı, projeksiyon ve şeytanlaştırmanın algıyı nasıl bozduğunu; sınırları korurken hakikati ve insan yüzünü yeniden görmeyi ele alan kitap.
learning: Olgular ile korkunun eklediği yorumları birbirinden ayırmak.
Tehlikeyi ciddiye alırken insanları tek bir etikete indirgememek.
Ödünç alınmış korkuları, dedikoduyu ve projeksiyonu fark etmek.
Kendi acımızın ve karanlık yanımızın yargıyı nasıl etkilediğini görmek.
Ayırt etme, sınır ve merhameti aynı anda taşıyabilen daha temiz bir bakış geliştirmek.

title: Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science
subtitle: A Visual Infographic Guide from Entropy and Gini to Python, Pruning, and Interpretable AI
summary: Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science explains tree models visually from first split to production-minded practice. It builds intuition for nodes, thresholds, entropy, Gini impurity, information gain, and split selection, then moves through ID3, C4.5, CART, overfitting, pruning, Python and scikit-learn, projects, interview questions, and reference material. Each concept is reinforced with definitions, formulas, numerical examples, code, outputs, common traps, model warnings, and mini cases, keeping interpretability and variance control visible throughout.
target_audience: For machine-learning students, data-science practitioners, interview candidates, and readers who value visual explanations and interpretable models.
seo_description: A visual decision-tree guide covering entropy, Gini, information gain, ID3, C4.5, CART, pruning, Python, interpretability, projects, and interview preparation.
learning: Understand how a tree transforms features and thresholds into recursive decisions.
Calculate and interpret entropy, Gini impurity, and information gain.
Compare major tree-building ideas such as ID3, C4.5, and CART.
Recognize overfitting and control complexity through pre-pruning and post-pruning.
Implement trees in Python and explain their behavior through projects and interview-style problems.

title: The Discipline of Bad Days
subtitle: Finish the Work Without Waiting to Feel Better
summary: The Discipline of Bad Days is about continuing meaningful work without pretending that every difficult day is ordinary. It distinguishes emergencies and genuine exhaustion from resistance, then replaces the demand for perfect motivation with smaller, humane minimum actions, return rituals, clean boundaries, rest that does not become desertion, and systems that reduce dependence on mood. Across forty-two chapters and a field manual, the book treats consistency as the ability to return rather than the ability to perform at maximum intensity every day.
target_audience: For writers, creators, professionals, students, and anyone who wants a humane system for continuing through low-motivation or difficult days.
seo_description: A practical guide to discipline on bad days: minimum actions, return rituals, energy, boundaries, rest, resistance, shame, and finishing work without waiting for motivation.
learning: Distinguish a hard day from an emergency, exhaustion, or simple resistance.
Scale work down without abandoning it completely when capacity is reduced.
Use minimum actions, return rituals, logs, and environment design to lower friction.
Rest without converting recovery into indefinite avoidance.
Build consistency around returning to the work rather than waiting for the right feeling.

title: Bırak Karma İşini Yapsın
subtitle: Huzur, Neşe, Bolluk ve İntikamsız Güç İçin Kozmik Dönüş Yasası
summary: Bırak Karma İşini Yapsın, karmayı tehdit, batıl inanç ya da pasiflik bahanesi olarak değil; insanın intikam, kanıt peşinde koşma ve başkalarının cezasını bizzat yönetme ihtiyacından çekilebilmesi için bir dönüş ve denge dili olarak ele alır. İhanet, öfke, sessizlik, sınırlar, affetme, bolluk, neşe ve otuz günlük uygulama haritası boyunca temel soru şudur: başkasının yaptığının karşılığını yönetmeye çalışmak yerine kendi davranışını, enerjini ve yönünü koruyabilir misin?
target_audience: İhanet, öfke veya intikam düşüncesinden çıkmak isteyen ama sınırlarından vazgeçmek istemeyen okurlar için.
seo_description: İntikam, ihanet, sınırlar, affetme, karma, iç huzur, enerji ve ileriye doğru yaşamak üzerine pratik ve düşünsel bir rehber.
learning: Karmayı tehdit ve pasiflikten ayırarak dönüş ve denge fikri olarak okumak.
İntikamın dikkat ve enerji maliyetini fark etmek.
Sınır koymayı cezalandırma gösterisine dönüştürmeden uygulamak.
Affetme ile yeniden erişim vermenin aynı şey olmadığını görmek.
Hayatı kanıt ve karşılık beklemek yerine kendi davranışın etrafında yeniden kurmak.

title: Hayatı Kontrol Edemezsin
subtitle: Öngörülemez Bir Dünyada Duygusal Disiplin, İç Denge ve Bilgece Hareket Etmek
summary: Hayatı Kontrol Edemezsin; Ama Tepkini Eğitebilirsin, kontrol yanılsaması çöktüğünde geriye kalan gerçek gücü inceler: tepkiyi seçme ve eğitme kapasitesi. Kitap duyguları bastırmak yerine duygusal hava olarak okumayı; duraklama, dikkat, beden, dil, sınırlar, gecikmiş yanıt, başarısızlık, kayıp, para, iş, ilişkiler ve dijital uyarılma içinde daha bilinçli hareket etmeyi ele alır. Son bölümler kişisel bir tepki protokolü ve zor gün denetimi oluşturur.
target_audience: Belirsizlikte daha sakin, esnek ve bilinçli davranmak isteyen kişisel gelişim okurları için.
seo_description: Kontrol edilemeyen olaylar karşısında duygusal disiplin, duraklama, beden, dikkat, sınırlar ve eğitilebilir tepkiler üzerine pratik rehber.
learning: Kontrol edilemeyen olaylarla seçilebilir tepkileri birbirinden ayırmak.
Duyguyu emir olarak değil, bilgi taşıyan geçici bir hava olarak okumak.
Duraklama, gecikmiş yanıt, dikkat ve beden pratikleriyle otomatik tepkiyi yavaşlatmak.
Kayıp, başarısızlık, iş, para ve ilişkilerde daha esnek planlar kurmak.
Kendi kişisel tepki protokolünü ve zor gün denetimini oluşturmak.

title: Sen Daha Azı İçin Fazla Değerlisin
subtitle: Özdeğer, yüksek standartlar, sağlık, aşk, inanç ve yapay zekâ kaldıraçlarıyla daha az israf, daha fazla sonuç üzerine insani bir kitap
summary: Sen Daha Azı İçin Fazla Değerlisin, özdeğeri üstünlük iddiası olarak değil, hayatın hangi alanlarında kendini sessizce ucuzlattığını görme yeteneği olarak ele alır. İlişkiler, dikkat, beden, sağlık, enerji, inançlar, zihinsel beslenme, aşk, arzu, seçicilik ve gereksiz acı üzerinden standartların nasıl kurulduğunu inceler. Yapay zekâ ise peygamber ya da otorite değil, düşünmeyi hızlandıran ve israfı azaltabilen bir kaldıraç olarak çerçevelenir.
target_audience: Özdeğerini daha somut standartlara çevirmek ve hayatındaki gereksiz israfı azaltmak isteyen okurlar için.
seo_description: Özdeğer, yüksek standartlar, sağlık, dikkat, aşk, seçicilik ve yapay zekâ kaldıraçlarıyla daha az israf ve daha yüksek yaşam kalitesi üzerine.
learning: Özdeğeri kibirden ayırarak davranış ve seçim düzeyinde tanımlamak.
İnsanların, alışkanlıkların ve dikkat tüketiminin değeri nasıl düşürdüğünü görmek.
Beden, enerji, inanç ve zihinsel beslenmeyi standartların parçası yapmak.
Aşk ve arzuyu öz-terk etmeden yaşamak için seçicilik geliştirmek.
Yapay zekâyı karar otoritesi değil, daha az israf için akıllı bir yardımcı olarak kullanmak.

title: Kötü Gün Disiplini
subtitle: Daha İyi Hissetmeyi Beklemeden İşi Bitir
summary: Kötü Gün Disiplini, zor bir günde kapasite azalırken insanın kendisini terk etmeden nasıl çalışabileceğini araştırır. Kitap gerçek acil durum ve tükenme ile direnci birbirinden ayırır; mükemmel motivasyon yerine küçük minimum eylemler, geri dönüş ritüelleri, çevre tasarımı, enerji yönetimi, temiz hayır, dinlenme ve utançtan sonra yeniden başlama üzerinde durur. Disiplin burada kendine şiddet değil, kötü günde bile ilişkiyi tamamen koparmamaktır.
target_audience: Yazarlık, üretim, çalışma ya da öğrenme süreçlerinde motivasyona fazla bağımlı kalmak istemeyen okurlar için.
seo_description: Motivasyon düşükken minimum eylem, geri dönüş ritüeli, enerji, dinlenme, sınır ve sürdürülebilir disiplin üzerine pratik rehber.
learning: Zor gün, acil durum, tükenme ve direnç arasındaki farkı görmek.
Kapasite düşünce işi küçültmek ama tamamen terk etmemek.
Minimum eylem, çevre tasarımı ve geri dönüş ritüelleri kullanmak.
Dinlenmeyi iyileşme için kullanırken kaçınmaya dönüşmesini fark etmek.
Disiplini kendine şiddet değil, tekrar tekrar geri dönebilme becerisi olarak kurmak.

title: Meta-Mevcudiyet
subtitle: Dikkati Çalmak Üzere Tasarlanmış Bir Dünyada Onu Korumak
summary: Meta-Mevcudiyet, modern hayatın dikkati açık saldırılardan çok; yararlı araçlar, konfor, verimlilik, eğlence, yapay zekâ, filtreler, FOMO ve duygusal uyarılma üzerinden nasıl parçalayabildiğini inceler. Kitap teknolojiye ya da hazza düşmanlık önermez; merkezine 'velayet' fikrini koyar: insanın dikkatinin canlı anahtarını kimin tuttuğunu fark etmesi ve kullandığı araçlardan sonra hâlâ kendi hayatına geri dönebilen kişi olarak kalması. Bölümler görünür ve gizli dikkat hırsızlarından yapay zekâya, duyuların ele geçirilmesine, bedensizleşmeye, tasarlanmış arzuya, duygusal yakalanmaya ve tanıklığın farklı pencerelerine ilerler. Kısa Meta-Mevcudiyet pratikleri; FOMO, dikkat, beden, arzu ve günlük seçimleri gözlemleyerek daha fazla uyarılma ile daha fazla canlılık arasındaki farkı görmeye çağırır.
target_audience: Dijital gürültü, yapay zekâ, bildirimler, FOMO, verimlilik baskısı ve sürekli uyarılma içinde dikkatini ve iç mevcudiyetini korumak isteyen modern okurlar için.
seo_description: Dikkat ekonomisi, yapay zekâ, FOMO, duyular, beden, tasarlanmış arzu ve duygusal yakalanma karşısında kendi mevcudiyetini korumaya yönelik modern bir farkındalık rehberi.
learning: Dikkatin nasıl açık zorlamadan çok yararlı, rahat veya verimli görünen sistemler içinde parçalanabildiğini fark etmek.
Teknoloji ve yapay zekâyı reddetmeden, kullanım sonrası daha canlı mı yoksa yalnızca daha uyarılmış mı olduğunu sormak.
Dijital görüntü, ses, filtre, eğlence ve kişiselleştirilmiş önerilerin duyular ve arzu üzerindeki etkisini gözlemlemek.
FOMO’yu gerçekten istenen hayatla karşılaştırmak ve başkasına ait bir geleceği kendi bugününün önüne koymamak.
Beden, uyku, yürüyüş, nefes ve sessizlik üzerinden dikkati yeniden somut hayata bağlamak.
Mevcudiyeti tek seferlik bir sakinlik hâli değil, tekrar tekrar geri dönebilme kapasitesi olarak kurmak.

title: Artık Bir Sebep İstemediğin Gün:
subtitle: Kabullenme, sakinleşme ve cevapsız sonların içinden geçmek için şiirsel ve uygulanabilir bir rehber
summary: Artık Bir Sebep İstemediğin Gün, bir ilişkinin, kaybın ya da yarım kalmış hikâyenin ardından gelmeyen açıklamayı beklerken hayatın nasıl askıda kalabildiğini inceler. Kitap cevapsız sonlar, zihnin mahkemesi, mesaj bekleyen beden, boş sandalye, seçilmemek, sessizliği yorumlama, onaylamadan kabullenme, mesafe, kendi kapanışını kurma ve yeniden güvenme üzerine ilerler. Otuz kısa uygulama, cevabın yokluğunda bile hayatı yeniden hareket ettirmeyi hedefler.
target_audience: Açıklaması gelmemiş ayrılık, kayıp veya yarım kalmış bir hikâyenin içinden geçmeye çalışan okurlar için.
seo_description: Cevapsız sonlar, kabullenme, kapanış, sessizlik, özdeğer, mesafe ve açıklama gelmeden ileriye hareket etmek için şiirsel ve pratik rehber.
learning: Eksik bir açıklamanın hayatı nasıl askıda tuttuğunu fark etmek.
Sessizliği sonsuz yorum üretme zorunluluğundan ayırmak.
Kabullenmeyi onaylamak ya da yapılanı haklı çıkarmak sanmamak.
Kapanışı yalnızca karşı taraftan gelecek bir cevap olarak görmemek.
Küçük uygulamalarla hayatı cevapsızlığın çevresinde değil, yeniden kendi merkezinde kurmak.

title: Esaretsiz Zeka
subtitle: Yetenekli Zihni Düşük Kapasiteli Odaların Esaretinden Korumak
summary:
Esaretsiz Zeka, yüksek bilişsel ve duygusal kapasitenin yanlış insanlara, ilişkilere, rollere ve ortamlara erken teslim edilmesini inceleyen düşünsel bir kişisel gelişim kitabıdır. Metin kapasite ile insan değerini özellikle birbirinden ayırır; amacı insanları sıralamak değil, derinlik, güven, yaratıcılık, dikkat ve erişimin nerede güvenle tutulabileceğini göstermektir. Kitap çok erken açılan zihin, hızın kendini güvenlik sanması, her şeyi açıklama tuzağı ve hak edilmemiş erişim gibi sorunlarla başlar.

On iki bölüm boyunca eser; güvenin yavaş kurulması, üretimin onay arayışından ayrılması, zekâya bir misyon verilmesi, çökmeden yalnız kalmak, eşitsiz kapasiteyi nefretsiz görmek, duygusal zekâ, bağlanma, sinir sistemi, sessiz çıkış, profesyonel sınırlar, rol netliği ve omurgalı yumuşaklık üzerinde ilerler. Son bölümde özgür zihin, gücünü herkese dağıtan zihin değil, anahtarın kimde kalacağını bilen zihin olarak tanımlanır. Amaç sertleşmek değil; derinliği korurken insanlığını, şefkatini ve yaratıcı gücünü kiraya vermemektir.
target_audience: Zihinsel yoğunluğu, hassasiyeti veya bilişsel kapasitesi yüksek olduğu için ilişkilerde, işte ya da sosyal ortamlarda kendini aşırı açıklayan, fazla veren veya yanlış yere derinlik taşıyan okurlar; aynı zamanda üstünlük duygusuna kapılmadan daha güçlü sınırlar kurmak isteyen herkes için.
seo_description: Yüksek kapasiteli ve yetenekli zihinler için erişim, güven, sınırlar, misyon, yalnızlık, duygusal zekâ, profesyonel netlik ve kendini silmeden özgür kalma üzerine bir rehber.
learning: Bilişsel ya da duygusal kapasite farklarını insan değerine dair bir sıralamaya dönüştürmemek.
Erken güven, aşırı açıklama, onay arayışı ve orantısız duygusal yatırımın zihni nasıl esir alabildiğini fark etmek.
İç dünyaya erişimi tutarlılık, ilke ve zamanla kazanılan bir hak olarak görmek.
Yüksek kapasiteyi bir kur yapma ya da kabul görme aracına değil, misyona ve uzun vadeli üretime yönlendirmek.
Yalnızlığı çöküşe dönüştürmeden yürüyüş, çalışma, öğrenme ve iç yoldaşlık için kullanmak.
Analiz ile bağlanmayı ayırmak ve güven kararlarında sinir sisteminin sinyallerini hesaba katmak.
Uyumsuz ilişkilerden veya ortamlardan ayrılırken ayrılığı halka açık bir davaya ya da acılığı kimliğe dönüştürmemek.
Şefkati korurken dikkat, iş, erişim ve iç yaşam üzerindeki sahipliği güçlendiren sınırlar kurmak.

title: Micro Cheating
subtitle: The Quiet Betrayals of Modern Love
summary: Micro Cheating examines small, repeated behaviors that can erode trust before a relationship reaches the territory of a conventional affair. It distinguishes privacy from secrecy, friendship from emotional outsourcing, ordinary human error from recurring concealment, and forgiveness from self-abandonment. Across phones, messages, likes, former partners, workplace closeness, emotional backup relationships, boundaries, confession, repair, staying, leaving, and mature fidelity, the book seeks clarity rather than surveillance.
target_audience: For readers navigating trust, boundaries, digital behavior, and emotional fidelity in modern relationships.
seo_description: A relationship guide to micro-cheating, secrecy, digital intimacy, emotional boundaries, trust erosion, repair, and mature fidelity.
learning: Distinguish privacy from secrecy and friendship from emotional displacement.
Assess small behaviors through repetition, concealment, intention, and impact rather than labels alone.
Talk about digital boundaries before mistrust becomes surveillance.
Recognize the difference between a repairable mistake and a recurring pattern.
Protect self-respect while deciding whether trust can be rebuilt or a relationship should end.

title: Unenslaved Intelligence
subtitle: Guarding the Gifted Mind from Capture by Low-Capacity Rooms
summary:
Unenslaved Intelligence is a reflective guide to protecting unusual cognitive and emotional capacity from being consumed by environments, relationships, roles, and expectations that cannot hold it responsibly. The book is careful not to confuse capacity with human worth: its concern is not ranking people, but deciding where depth, attention, trust, creativity, and access can be placed safely. It begins with the gifted mind's tendency to open too early, explain too much, mistake speed for safety, and pour disproportionate energy into people or rooms that have not earned that access.

Across twelve chapters, the book develops a practical philosophy of earned access, disciplined creation, mission, solitude, unequal capacity without contempt, emotional intelligence, quiet exit, professional boundaries, tenderness with structure, and ownership of one's inner life. It argues that intelligence without custody can amplify pain as quickly as insight, and that freedom requires more than raw ability: it requires direction, boundaries, emotional maturity, role clarity, and a life that cannot be rented by every admirer, client, hope, mood, or relationship. The ending returns the key to the reader: depth can remain generous without becoming available to everyone.
key_topics: Gifted minds and high cognitive capacity
target_audience: For intellectually intense, highly sensitive, gifted or high-capacity readers who repeatedly find themselves overgiving attention, explanation, creativity or emotional access; and for readers who want stronger boundaries without superiority, cruelty or withdrawal from human connection.
seo_description: A reflective guide to protecting gifted and high-capacity minds through earned access, boundaries, mission, emotional intelligence, solitude, professional clarity and freedom from self-erasure.
learning: Separate differences in cognitive or emotional capacity from judgments about human worth.
Recognize when intelligence is being captured by premature trust, overexplaining, approval seeking or disproportionate emotional investment.
Make access to your inner world something that is earned through consistency, principle and time.
Direct high capacity toward mission, disciplined output and long-horizon work instead of using creation as a courtship strategy.
Use solitude, study, walking and deep work without turning isolation into collapse.
Distinguish analysis from attachment and include the nervous system in decisions about trust and relationships.
Leave misaligned situations without turning departure into a public trial or bitterness into identity.
Build professional and personal boundaries that preserve generosity while keeping ownership of your attention, work and inner life.

title: Claude AI for Small Business
subtitle: The Expanded Practical Guide to Automating Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations, HR, and Customer Support for Solopreneurs
summary:
Claude AI for Small Business reframes AI from a chat window into a reviewable operating system for a small business. Its central question is which repetitive tasks can be prepared, organized, analyzed, or drafted by Claude inside existing workflows while the owner remains responsible for approvals, customer relationships, and consequential decisions. The book begins with an AI command center built around workspace organization, approval rules, connectors, and reusable prompts, then moves through idea generation and market validation before applying the same operating discipline to finance, marketing, sales, support, legal and HR preparation, and day-to-day operations.

The practical model is deliberately cautious: Claude prepares; the owner approves. Financial work is reviewed rather than blindly automated, marketing emphasizes taste and consistency rather than volume, sales automation uses real context instead of invented personalization, and customer-support workflows preserve human authority over refunds, credits, replacements, and legal admissions. Legal and HR sections position AI as preparation rather than legal authority, while the operations chapter turns proven workflows into reusable skills, digital SOPs, and scheduled tasks. Implementation checklists, chapter prompt sets, and a 48-hour implementation plan are designed to help a solopreneur automate one department at a time instead of creating a fragile web of uncontrolled automation.
target_audience: For solopreneurs, freelancers, consultants, creators, and small-business owners who handle several business functions themselves and want a practical way to reduce manual work with Claude while keeping approvals, sensitive decisions, customer relationships, and professional review in human hands.
seo_description: A practical Claude AI guide for solopreneurs to build reviewable workflows for marketing, finance, sales, customer support, HR, legal preparation, operations, connectors, scheduled tasks, and reusable prompts.
learning: Turn Claude from an isolated chat tool into a small-business command center with organized context, approval rules, and connectors.
Validate business ideas and markets before investing heavily in production or automation.
Use AI to prepare finance and accounting reviews while keeping sensitive decisions under human control.
Create repeatable marketing and content workflows that preserve brand judgment instead of maximizing output for its own sake.
Support sales follow-up, lead qualification, and customer service with real context, explicit pipeline stages, and approval boundaries.
Use Claude for legal and HR preparation without treating model output as legal, payroll, tax, or compliance authority.
Convert successful operational routines into digital SOPs, reusable skills, and scheduled tasks only after the workflow has been proven.
Implement automation department by department so the business gains speed and consistency without losing human judgment.

title: The Power of Deletion
subtitle: Removing What Breaks Your Peace from the Life You Are Still Building
summary: The Power of Deletion treats removal as an act of attention and access management rather than cruelty. It explores the hidden cost of keeping people, habits, digital noise, guilt, status games, and internal loops that repeatedly disturb the life a person is trying to build. Family, friendship, love, work, social media, body signals, standards, gradual deletion, returning people, and clean boundary language are examined alongside a seven-day practice for creating space after removal.
target_audience: For readers who want clearer boundaries and less repeated disruption without turning self-protection into hostility.
seo_description: A practical guide to boundaries, attention, access, relationships, digital clutter, guilt, standards, and removing what repeatedly breaks inner peace.
learning: Treat deletion as a decision about access and attention rather than revenge.
Identify the hidden tax of repeated disturbance in relationships, habits, and digital life.
Use cleaner boundaries in family, friendship, love, and work.
Distinguish guilt from a genuine obligation to keep harmful access open.
Build a calmer life after removal instead of leaving an empty space.

title: You Can’t Control Life, But You Can Train Your Response
subtitle: Emotional Discipline, Inner Stability, and Wise Action in an Unpredictable World
summary: You Can’t Control Life, But You Can Train Your Response focuses on the agency that remains when events refuse to obey plans. It treats emotions as weather rather than commands and develops pause, attention, body awareness, language, boundaries, delayed response, flexible planning, and wise action across failure, delay, loss, work, money, relationships, and digital overstimulation. The closing framework helps the reader build a personal response protocol for difficult days and unpredictable situations.
target_audience: For readers who want greater stability and wiser action without pretending that life itself can be fully controlled.
seo_description: A practical guide to emotional discipline, pause, attention, body awareness, boundaries, uncertainty, flexible planning, and training responses instead of controlling life.
learning: Separate uncontrollable events from trainable responses.
Read emotions as information without treating them as automatic instructions.
Use pause, delayed response, attention, and body awareness to slow reaction.
Apply flexible plans and boundaries in work, money, relationships, and loss.
Create a personal response protocol for difficult and unpredictable days.

title: You Are Too Valuable for Less
subtitle: How to Protect Your Worth, Raise Your Standards, and Use Intelligent Leverage to Build a Higher Life
summary: You Are Too Valuable for Less defines self-worth through standards and choices rather than superiority. It asks where a person privately discounts time, health, attention, relationships, beliefs, appetite, and energy, then develops a framework for raising standards without turning life into perfectionism. Love and desire are examined alongside selectivity, unnecessary suffering, and intelligent leverage; AI is framed as a tool for reducing waste and accelerating thought, not as an authority over human judgment.
target_audience: For readers who want to translate self-respect into concrete standards and a less wasteful, higher-quality life.
seo_description: A practical book on self-worth, standards, health, attention, love, selectivity, intelligent leverage, and using AI without outsourcing judgment.
learning: Define self-worth through behavior and standards rather than superiority.
Find where time, health, attention, and relationships are being sold too cheaply.
Raise standards without confusing them with perfectionism or needless pain.
Practice selectivity in love, desire, habits, and mental diet.
Use AI as leverage for clearer work and less waste while keeping human judgment in charge.

title: The Day You Stop Needing a Reason
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Acceptance, Calm, and Moving Through Unanswered Endings
summary: The Day You Stop Needing a Reason examines what happens when life remains suspended beside an explanation that never arrives. Through unanswered endings, the courtroom of memory, the body waiting for a message, the empty chair, not being chosen, silence, distance, acceptance without approval, self-made closure, rebuilding, and trust after ambiguity, the book offers a way to move without pretending that unanswered questions do not hurt. Thirty practices turn the idea of closure into small acts rather than a final speech from someone else.
target_audience: For readers moving through a breakup, loss, rejection, or unfinished story that did not provide a satisfying explanation.
seo_description: A practical guide to unanswered endings, acceptance, closure, silence, distance, self-worth, rebuilding, and moving forward without receiving an explanation.
learning: Recognize how waiting for an explanation can keep a life psychologically suspended.
Stop treating silence as a puzzle that must be solved indefinitely.
Understand acceptance without confusing it with approval of what happened.
Build closure through your own actions when no final answer is available.
Use small practices to rebuild movement, trust, and attention after an unanswered ending.

title: The Monster in the Mirror
subtitle: How Fear Turns Other People Into Shadows, and How Awareness Restores the Face of Truth
summary: The Monster in the Mirror explores how fear, pain, rumor, and judgment can flatten another person into a frightening symbol. It does not ask readers to deny danger or abandon boundaries; it asks them to separate fact from fear, discernment from demonization, and protection from projection. Fourteen chapters and a twenty-one-day mirror practice examine borrowed monsters, gossip, hidden wounds, the pause before judgment, one’s own shadow, and the possibility of restoring a human face without surrendering clarity.
target_audience: For readers interested in self-awareness, fear, judgment, and the ethics of seeing other people more accurately.
seo_description: A reflective guide to fear, judgment, projection, demonization, boundaries, gossip, self-awareness, and restoring clearer perception.
learning: Separate observable danger from stories amplified by fear and projection.
Use discernment without reducing a whole person to a single frightening label.
Recognize borrowed fears, gossip, and unresolved pain in judgment.
Examine one's own shadow before assigning all darkness to others.
Hold boundaries and clarity while restoring a more human view of reality.

title: Day Trading from Zero
subtitle: A Practical AI-Assisted Roadmap for Beginners
summary: Day Trading from Zero builds a beginner’s roadmap around chart reading, market structure, risk, testing, and disciplined use of AI. It distinguishes day trading from investing, introduces markets, instruments, spreads, slippage, fees, sessions, watchlists, candlesticks, timeframes, support and resistance, volume, trend, range, liquidity, and Fair Value Gaps, then connects them to position sizing, expectancy, leverage, margin, and liquidation. AI is used for learning, chart review, journaling, and structured thinking rather than as an oracle or permission to trade.
target_audience: For serious beginners who want a structured, risk-aware introduction to day trading with AI used as a learning and review assistant.
seo_description: A beginner day-trading guide to markets, chart reading, structure, risk, leverage, testing, journaling, and disciplined AI-assisted learning.
learning: Understand the practical differences between day trading and longer-term investing.
Read basic chart structure, candles, timeframes, levels, volume, trends, ranges, and liquidity.
Calculate risk, position size, reward-to-risk, expectancy, and leverage exposure.
Use simulation, testing, and journaling before relying on live capital.
Use AI to organize learning and review evidence without treating it as a trading oracle.

title: AI-Assisted Crypto Futures
subtitle: The Smart Three-Screenshot Method for Multi-Timeframe Futures Trading
summary: AI-Assisted Crypto Futures presents a three-screenshot workflow for turning multi-timeframe chart evidence into a written futures plan before an order is placed. It covers futures mechanics, safe account setup, screenshot quality, timeframe hierarchy, market structure, invalidation, liquidity, Fair Value Gaps, prompt design, position sizing, leverage, stops, take-profit logic, execution, and no-trade decisions. AI is positioned as a structured assistant for evidence review and risk auditing, while the order screen and written plan remain subject to human verification.
target_audience: For crypto futures traders who want a structured AI-assisted workflow centered on evidence and risk rather than prediction.
seo_description: A practical three-screenshot method for AI-assisted crypto futures analysis, covering multi-timeframe structure, liquidity, FVGs, prompts, risk, leverage, and execution.
learning: Capture evidence consistently across multiple timeframes before asking AI for analysis.
Define market structure, liquidity, invalidation, and setup logic from the screenshots.
Write prompts that separate bias, zones, triggers, conflicts, stops, and targets.
Audit position size, leverage, liquidation risk, and order details before clicking.
Use AI as a review assistant while keeping execution authority and responsibility human.

title: Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself
subtitle: How to Move Beyond Someone Who Is Not Willing to Stay Without Abandoning Who You Are
summary: Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself is a literary and practical guide to what remains after a person, role, job, friendship, home, dream, or old identity leaves. Its concern is not condemning departure but preventing the person left behind from disappearing from their own body, work, sleep, self-respect, calendar, and future. Across twenty-one chapters, the book moves through ambiguous endings, the mind’s demand for explanations, holding on, silent begging, the empty place, returning to the body, leaving waiting mode, making room for emptiness, refusing to build an identity around the wound, allowing joy back in, and letting the absent become ordinary again. The central discipline is simple: let departure be real without granting it final authority over the life that remains.
target_audience: For readers moving through breakups, fading friendships, job loss, relocation, abandoned dreams, or other departures and who want to grieve without abandoning their own life.
seo_description: A practical and literary guide to grief, ambiguous endings, self-respect, body, waiting, closure, boundaries, joy, and rebuilding life after someone or something leaves.
learning: Recognize endings that arrive through changed behavior rather than a formal goodbye.
Separate another person’s decision to leave from the value of the life that remains.
Stop turning unanswered questions into an endless internal courtroom.
Return attention to body, sleep, work, money, friendships and ordinary routines before rewriting the whole future.
Allow empty space and grief without letting either become the government of daily life.
Rebuild through small acts of self-loyalty rather than hostility toward whoever left.

title: Art as a Ladder to the Soul
subtitle: How Creativity, Beauty, Silence, and Witness Awaken the Inner Life
summary: Art as a Ladder to the Soul argues that creativity is not merely decoration, achievement, or entertainment but one of the forms through which a person can regain contact with an inner life thinned by speed, usefulness, performance, and constant visibility. It begins with inward fatigue, distance from one's own center, and the difference between art as escape and art as return. The book then explores why the soul needs art, creation before achievement, the forgotten language of feeling, music, drawing, writing, movement, beginnerhood, solitude, silence, beauty, numbness, and the artist as witness. Its concern is not professional artistry but the human capacity to feel, shape, witness, and offer what life is doing within. Distinct practices include listening, sketching, journaling, freewriting, movement, private dance, breath, unskilled creation, solitude, beautiful attention, thawing numbness, and ethical witness. The final movement asks the reader to protect hidden work, practice before mood, let beauty guide daily life, remain a beginner, witness what must not be lost, and carry the ladder into ordinary life.
target_audience: For artists and non-artists alike, especially readers who feel inwardly tired, overfunctional, perfectionistic, creatively blocked, emotionally numb, or disconnected from beauty and want practical ways to use art, silence, embodiment, and witness as forms of return.
seo_description: A deep practical meditation on creativity, music, drawing, writing, movement, beginnerhood, solitude, beauty, numbness, witness, and using art to return to presence and inner life.
learning: Recognize the difference between outward functioning and inward nourishment, and the role art can play in reconnecting the two.
Create before achievement by separating private practice from applause, market value, and perfection.
Use music, drawing, writing, and movement as different languages for feelings that may appear before clear explanation.
Practice beginnerhood without treating lack of skill as evidence that creativity does not belong to you.
Use solitude, silence, beauty, and attention as conditions in which inner material can ripen rather than be forced.
Work with numbness gradually through art, embodiment, tenderness, and shared feeling instead of demanding immediate drama.
Treat witnessing as an ethical practice that can hold suffering, joy, memory, community, and ordinary life without exploitation.
Build a durable creative life through small practices, hidden work, repetition, and a return to ordinary reality.

title: Do the Thing
subtitle: Why Preparation Feels Like Progress—and How to Finally Act
summary: Do the Thing studies the distance between preparing for a life and changing it through action. It begins with respectable forms of delay: cleaner systems, more research, better tools, improved plans, public intentions, and endless readiness. It distinguishes support work from state-changing work and follows the psychology of almost through undefined goals, fear of exposure, identity built around delay, and the comfort of remaining in potential rather than contacting reality. Action is treated as the mechanism that produces feedback, reduces ambiguity, rewrites identity, and teaches the body that beginning can be survived. The middle sections develop an action psychology built around starting before certainty, finishing small things, letting clarity emerge after movement, treating motivation as a result, and using repeatable wins. The later action system becomes concrete: define one real next step, design the first ten minutes, remove friction, use cues and calendars, create bounded time containers, finish open loops, handle emotionally difficult tasks, recover quickly after interruption, and collect evidence instead of hype. summary:
MACD Trading Mastery is a seven-part master collection built to move the reader beyond the familiar habit of treating MACD as a traffic light. The collection brings together MACD Foundations; MACD Histogram Trading; MACD Crossovers & Zero-Line Trading; MACD Divergence Trading; MACD Trend Following; Multi-Timeframe MACD; and MACD Confluence. Across the full sequence, the indicator is treated as a mathematical transformation of price that must be interpreted inside market structure, regime, timeframe and risk rather than as a stand-alone prediction engine.

The opening material develops the mechanics of the MACD line, signal line, histogram and zero line, then separates trend from momentum and shows why price should be read before the indicator. The histogram volume focuses on acceleration and deceleration before a crossover. The crossover and zero-line material reframes late signals as context-aware evidence rather than automatic entries. The divergence section covers regular, hidden and structural divergence without turning every disagreement between price and momentum into a reversal forecast. Trend-following chapters examine bull and bear markets with momentum confirmation, while the multi-timeframe framework assigns distinct jobs to Daily, 4H, 1H, 15-minute and 5-minute charts so lower-timeframe noise cannot casually overrule higher-timeframe context.

The final confluence volume connects MACD with RSI, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend, Ichimoku, Stochastic and ATR while warning against false confidence created by stacking indicators that are often derived from the same price data. Throughout the collection, readers encounter chart-reading protocols, observation journals, alignment matrices, checklists, historical or clearly labeled schematic figures, and explicit invalidation logic. The practical goal is not to make MACD infallible. It is to make interpretation more accountable: describe what the calculation actually supports, identify what remains uncertain, decide what evidence would change the thesis, and keep position sizing and risk independent from indicator enthusiasm.
target_audience: For stock, futures, forex, commodity and crypto traders who already recognize MACD on a chart but want a much deeper, structured understanding of momentum, trend, divergence, multi-timeframe analysis and confluence. subtitle: When You Spend Tomorrow Today — How Easy Monthly Payments Can Quietly Mortgage Your Future
summary:
The Installment Trap examines one of the most persuasive illusions in everyday consumer finance: the idea that a small monthly payment must represent a small financial decision. The book does not argue that all installment credit is bad. It shows how financing can sometimes protect liquidity, bridge a timing mismatch or make a necessary purchase possible, while also explaining why the same tool can become dangerous when a buyer looks only at the payment and not at total cost, future obligations, household margin, income reliability and exit options. Its central question is not simply, ‘Can I make this payment this month?’ but ‘How much future freedom remains if life does not unfold exactly as expected?’

Across thirty chapters, the book follows the entire life cycle of an installment decision. It explains how ‘I do not have the money’ can quietly become ‘I can afford the monthly payment’; why future income is not yet free money; how the phrase ‘only X per month’ shrinks attention; why zero interest does not automatically mean zero cost; and why lender approval is not the same as personal affordability. It then looks at the cumulative effect of several small obligations, due-date collisions, falling income, rising living costs, irregular expenses, emergency funds, depreciation, negative equity, forced resale and the uncomfortable possibility of still paying for something whose usefulness or excitement has already disappeared.

The later chapters move from diagnosis to decision-making. They examine status spending, self-proof, FOMO, optimistic assumptions about future income, alternatives to financing, debt mapping, rescuing old debt with new debt, keep-or-sell decisions, financial flexibility and the effect of installment pressure on relationships. Practical examples repeatedly reconstruct the full decision by putting total cost, term length, fees, residual monthly margin, downside scenarios and exit routes back on the page. The result is a financial-literacy guide about preserving choice. It is designed to help readers tell the difference between credit that serves a plan and credit that quietly turns future income into a calendar of promises.
target_audience: For consumers who use installment plans, BNPL, store financing, personal credit or long payment schedules; for households and freelancers with variable or tight cash flow; and for readers who want a practical framework for making purchase decisions without shame, anti-credit dogma or simplistic rules.

Kitabın ilerleyen bölümleri statü için tüketim, FOMO, iyimser gelecek varsayımları, kredi limiti, beklemenin ekonomik değeri, ikinci el seçenekleri, tamir mi değiştirme mi sorusu, üç gelecek testi, sözleşmeyi rakamlarla okuma, borç haritası çıkarma, eski borcu yeni borçla kurtarma, aile içindeki finansal gerilim ve taksidin hangi koşullarda gerçekten mantıklı olabileceği üzerinde durur. Amaç tüketimden korkutmak değil, kararın direksiyonunu yeniden okuyucuya vermektir. Kitabın temel ölçütü şudur: iyi bir finansman kararı yalnızca bu ay ödenebilen değil, kötü bir ay geldiğinde de hayatın manevra alanını tamamen ortadan kaldırmayan karardır.

subtitle: Wenn wir das Morgen für heute ausgeben — Wie kleine Monatszahlungen zukünftige Freiheit binden – und wie man klüger entscheidet
summary:
Die Ratenfalle macht eine besonders wirksame Illusion der Alltagsfinanzen sichtbar: Eine kleine Monatsrate wirkt wie eine kleine Entscheidung, obwohl sie Einkommen und Handlungsspielraum vieler zukünftiger Monate binden kann. Das Buch ist weder kreditfeindlich noch konsumfeindlich. Es zeigt, dass Raten vernünftig sein können, wenn sie Liquidität schützen, eine notwendige Anschaffung ermöglichen oder einen echten zeitlichen Engpass überbrücken. Entscheidend ist jedoch, ob nach Gesamtpreis, Laufzeit, laufenden Kosten, Einkommenssicherheit und möglichen Rückschlägen noch genügend finanzieller Spielraum bleibt.

In dreißig Kapiteln wird die Entscheidung systematisch auseinandergebaut. Das Buch erklärt, wie aus ‘Ich habe das Geld nicht’ unmerklich ‘49 Euro im Monat passen noch hinein’ wird, warum zukünftiges Einkommen noch nicht frei verfügbares Geld ist, weshalb ‘nur X Euro im Monat’ den Blick verengt und warum null Prozent Finanzierung nicht automatisch null Kosten bedeutet. Es trennt Kreditgenehmigung von persönlicher Tragfähigkeit und zeigt, wie mehrere kleine Raten gemeinsam eine große Wand bilden können. Einkommensrückgang, steigende Lebenshaltungskosten, unregelmäßige Ausgaben, Notgroschen, Wertverlust, Restschuld, Wiederverkauf und die Möglichkeit eines erzwungenen Verkaufs werden als Teile derselben Entscheidung behandelt.

Die späteren Kapitel erweitern den Blick um Statuskonsum, FOMO, Optimismus über die eigene Zukunft, Alternativen vor der Finanzierung, Schuldenübersicht, neue Schulden zur Rettung alter Schulden, Behalten-oder-Verkaufen-Entscheidungen, Belastungen in Beziehungen und die Frage, wann Raten tatsächlich vernünftig sein können. Die deutsche Ausgabe wurde für natürlichen deutschen Lesefluss und eigenständige Alltagssituationen formuliert. Ihr Ziel ist keine Angst-Rhetorik, sondern Präzision: Gesamtbelastung sichtbar machen, mehrere Zukunftsszenarien prüfen, die Exit-Tür vor dem Kauf mitdenken und finanzielle Freiheit als den Teil des zukünftigen Einkommens verstehen, über den noch nicht im Voraus verfügt wurde.
target_audience: Für Verbraucherinnen und Verbraucher, die Ratenkauf, BNPL, Händlerfinanzierung oder andere Konsumentenkredite nutzen; für Haushalte mit engem oder schwankendem Budget; und für Leser, die Kreditentscheidungen ohne Schuldzuweisung, Angst-Rhetorik oder pauschale Verbote nüchtern prüfen möchten.

subtitle: Yapay Genel Zekâya Giden Yolda İnsan Sorumluluğu ve Doğru ile Yanlışın Yeni Sınırları
summary:
Yapay Zekâ Çağında Etik, yapay zekânın günlük yaşamdan eğitime, çalışma hayatından ilişkilere ve kamusal kararlara kadar giderek daha fazla alanı etkilediği bir dönemde doğru ile yanlışın sınırlarının nasıl yeniden tartışılması gerektiğini ele alır. Kitap, etik tartışmayı soyut ilkelerle sınırlamak yerine sorumluluk, mahremiyet, algoritmik ayrımcılık, gözetim, manipülasyon, deepfake'ler, açıklanabilirlik, belirsizlik ve insan denetimi gibi somut sorunlar üzerinden kurar.

Eser ayrıca otonom sistemler ve ajanlar, yapay genel zekâya giden yol, makine bilinci ve olası makine hakları gibi daha ileri tartışmalara uzanırken temel soruyu sürekli korur: karar verme yetkisi ve sonuçların sorumluluğu nerede insanda kalmalıdır? Eğitimde yapay zekâ kullanımı, iş ve becerilerin dönüşümü, ilişkiler, ebeveynlik, algoritmik eşleşme ve dijital yakınlık gibi gündelik konular da bu etik çerçevenin parçası olarak incelenir.

Kitabın yaklaşımı, teknolojiyi şeytanlaştırmak ya da romantikleştirmek yerine insan öznesini, hesap verebilirliği ve bilinçli gözetimi merkeze almaktır. Amaç, yapay zekâ ile birlikte yaşarken yalnızca neyin mümkün olduğunu değil, neyin kabul edilebilir, adil, sorumlu ve insan onuruyla uyumlu olduğunu da sorgulamaktır.

subtitle: Human Responsibility on the Road to Artificial General Intelligence and the New Boundaries of Right and Wrong
summary:
Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence examines how the boundaries of right and wrong must be reconsidered as AI systems increasingly shape everyday life, education, work, relationships, public decision-making, and access to opportunity. Rather than treating ethics as an abstract philosophical layer added after deployment, the book frames responsibility, privacy, algorithmic bias, surveillance, manipulation, deepfakes, explainability, uncertainty, and human oversight as practical design and governance questions.

The book also moves toward more advanced questions involving autonomous systems and agents, the road toward artificial general intelligence, machine consciousness, and the possibility of future machine rights, while preserving a central question throughout: where should authority, accountability, and final responsibility remain with human beings? AI in education, the transformation of work and skills, parenting, algorithmic matching, digital intimacy, and technology-mediated relationships are examined within the same ethical framework.

Its approach is neither alarmist nor celebratory. The emphasis is on preserving human agency, accountability, dignity, and deliberate oversight while distinguishing what technology can do from what it should be allowed to do. The result is a practical ethical framework for readers who want to understand not only the capabilities of modern AI, but also the social and human responsibilities created by those capabilities.
key_topics: Machine consciousness and possible machine rights
target_audience: For students, educators, developers, researchers, managers, entrepreneurs, policymakers, technology professionals, and general readers who want a practical framework for understanding the ethical consequences of artificial intelligence.
